Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a fiery tonic, increasing damage done by 5% and your critical strike chance by 5% for 15 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Pyroclysm
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Launch into the air, dealing 23 Fire damage, knocking back enemies within 6 yds and dazing them for 6 sec.    Upon landing, deal 11 Fire damage, knock back enemies within 6 yds and daze them for 6 sec.

Name: Quake
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    2 Charges, 8 sec recharge  Stomp the ground, dealing Weapon Damage plus 14 Nature damage to enemies within 8 yds and reduces their melee and ranged haste by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Quick Draw
Description: A quick shot that deals 81% weapon damage.    Max 3 charges. 20 second recharge timer. Casting Mongoose Bite or Counterattack restores a charge.    This uses Steady Shot modifiers.

Name: Radiance
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Every 2 sec you burst with light, healing nearby allies for 17 and damaging nearby enemies for 19. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Raging Lunge
Description: Deals 150% Weapon damage up to 5 enemies in front of you.     Becoming Enraged enables one use of Raging Lunge. You can store up to 2 charges.    This uses Raging Blow modifiers.  Multiple Raging Blow! charges cannot be gained within the same global cooldown. Does not receive a charge from Wrecking Crew.

Name: Rain of Arrows
Description: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 106 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 5 yards every 3.00 seconds for 9 sec.    Scales with Volley modifiers.

Name: Ray of Frost
Description: Channel an icy beam at the target for 5 sec, dealing 32 Frost damage every 1 sec, slowing the target by 23%.    Each time Ray of Frost deals damage, its damage and snare is increased by 20%.

Name: Razorlash
Description: Lash out with razor-sharp vines, dealing 31 Nature damage and causing the target to bleed for 10 physical damage every 2 seconds for 10 sec.     This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Razzashi Talon
Description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 100% weapon damage plus an additional 20, increased by 5% (up to 50%) per bleed you applied to your target. Awards 2 combo points.    This uses Mutilate modifiers.

Name: Reave
Description: This spell belongs to Bloodmage    Lacerate an enemy, dealing 65% Weapon Damage plus 26.    If you are behind the enemy or the enemy is bleeding, deal 100% additional Shadow damage for each matching condition. If the enemy is below 35% health, deal 125% additional Shadow damage.

Name: Resonance Rune
Description: This spell belongs to Runemaster    Place an arcane rune on the ground that dispels 3 harmful magic effects from allies in the radius, and purges 3 beneficial magic effects from enemies.

Name: Reverse Magic
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller    Reverse the next spell cast on you within 3 sec, reflecting it back to its caster.    Reversing a spell in this way drains 150 of the attacker's mana.

Name: Righteous Execution
Description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 65% of 65 Holystrike damage and converting each extra point of rage into 65% of 2 additional Holystrike damage (up to a maximum cost of 30 rage). Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.  This uses Execute modifiers.

Name: Righteous Multi-Shot
Description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for 65% weapon damage as Holystrike.  This uses Multi-Shot modifiers.

Name: Rime Breaker
Description: Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect. In addition, causes 78% weapon damage (62% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 3 as Froststrike damage for each application of Sunder Armor on the target. The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 5 times.    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.    This uses Devastate modifiers.

Name: Rime Lash
Description: You charge your off-hand weapon with elemental force, instantly dealing 100% off-hand Weapon damage as Froststrike damage.     Damage is increased by 25% if your off-hand weapon is enchanted with Windfury.    This uses Lava Lash modifiers.

Name: Rime Revenge
Description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 58 to 70 Froststrike damage. Icy Vengeance is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.  This uses Revenge modifiers.

Name: Rime Strike
Description: An instant frost-infused strike that causes 3 Froststrike damage in addition to 65% of your normal weapon damage (55% if a two-handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Roaring Pyre
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Conjure a Roaring Pyre at the target location for 20 sec.    Allies within 30 yds of the bonfire are healed for 41, scaling with your Spirit and healing spell power, every 2 sec and their Spirit is increased by 10%.

Name: Rock Barrier
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    2 Charges, 20 sec recharge Raise rocks from beneath you, increasing your Armor by 98, scaling with your Stamina. Lasts for 10 attacks or 10 sec.    Expending a charge of Rock Barrier launches a Geode at the enemy.  Geode Hurl an enchanted stone at the target, dealing 2 Physical damage.

Name: Rocket Boots
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    3 Charges, 30 sec recharge  Activate your Rocket Boots launching you forwards.

Name: Rocket Launcher
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Fire a powerful rocket at an enemy that deals 78 Fire damage.

Name: Roll Back
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Roll back time, dispelling the last harmful effect placed on an ally.    Subsequent uses increases the mana cost of this ability by 50% for 5 sec.

Name: Rotting Breath
Description: Deals 170 to 207 Plague damage to enemies in a cone in front of you and applies Rotting.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    This uses Dragon's Breath modifiers.    Rotting Deals Plague damage every 3 seconds and increases your damage dealt with Physical, Shadow or Nature spells and abilities by 8% for 9 seconds.

Name: Runic Hurricane
Description: This spell belongs to Runemaster    Strike an enemy 5 times over 2 sec, each strike dealing 50% Weapon Damage as Nature Damage.    While striking your target, your chance to dodge is increased by 100%, but you cannot use any spells or abilities.

Name: Saber Slash
Description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point:    1 point  : 159-261 damage    2 points: 292-394 damage    3 points: 426-528 damage    4 points: 559-661 damage    5 points: 693-795 damage    Spreads your Rupture when used at 5 points.

Name: Sacred Grove
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  This spell belongs to Primalist    Create a Sacred Grove in a 15 yd radius around you for 16 sec, instantly healing nearby party and raid members for 1003.    While active, allies in the grove receive 25% increased healing and regain 2% of their missing health every 2 sec.

Name: Salamander Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 11 Firestrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Savage Blade
Description: You throw a Savage Blade at the enemy, dealing 150% ranged weapon damage.

Name: Scorched Earth
Description: Scorch the enemy for 50 to 61 Fire damage. This can be cast while moving.    This uses Scorch modifiers.

Name: Screams of the Past
Description: Unleash a chorus of screams from the past inflicting Psychic Trauma on nearby enemies, causing them flee for 6 sec, be silenced for 5 sec and take 15 Shadow damage every 2 sec for 10 sec.    This uses Psychic Scream modifiers.

Name: Seal of Arcane Wrath
Description: Fills the Paladin with arcane spirit, Paladin melee abilities, and main hand auto attacks deal additional Arcane damage.    Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 4 Arcane damage to an enemy.    Scales with Seal of Righteousness modifiers.    Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Name: Seal of Ebon Vengeance
Description: Fills you with ebon power, causing Paladin and Death Knight melee abilities to apply Ebon Corruption, which deals 40 additional Shadow damage over 15 sec.  Ebon Corruption can stack up to 5 times. Once stacked to 5 times, each of your Paladin and Death Knight melee abilities deals damage as additional Shadow damage. Only one Seal can be active on the caster at any one time. Lasts until cancelled.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 170 Shadow damage to an enemy, increased by 10% for each application of Ebon Corruption on the target.    This uses Seal of Vengeance modifiers.

Name: Seal of Fervor
Description: Fills you with fiery spirit, granting each main hand auto attack and Paladin melee ability 1 additional Fire damage. Only one Seal can be active at one time.    Unleashing this Seal's energy burns the enemy, dealing 2 Fire damage every second for 3 seconds.    Scales with Seal of Righteousness damage modifiers.

Name: Searing Brand
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Burn an enemy, inflicting 112 Fire damage over 21 sec. If Searing Brand is dispelled, it deals 111 Fire damage to the dispeller.    Castable while moving. Cremation can consume this effect and includes its remaining periodic damage.

Name: Seismic Tremor
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Send a tremor through the earth at an enemy, dealing 52 Physical damage, plus an additional 248 over 24 sec. Damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up over time.     Shares a cooldown with other |CffffffffSeismic|r spells.

Name: Seismic Wave
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Create a seismic wave of healing water around you, healing for 28 health to up to 8 allies and dealing 48 Nature damage to enemies in a 25 yd radius.      Shares a cooldown with other |CffffffffSeismic|r spells.

Name: Sentinel Glaive
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller    Throw a sentinel glaive at an enemy, dealing Weapon Damage plus 105 as Arcane damage, increased further based on your maximum mana, and increasing their resource costs by 15% for 8 sec.

Name: Serpent Form
Description: Transforms you into a Serpent, increasing melee attack power by 1 plus 25% of Agility, allowing the use of Cat Form abilities, and causing your auto attacks to also inflict Poisonous Strikes, dealing an additional 10 Nature damage.    This ability uses Cat Form modifiers and Poisonous Strikes uses Instant Poison modifiers.

Name: Serpent Strike
Description: Strike the enemy, causing 80% weapon damage plus 15 damage as Nature and granting you Serpent Strike. Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Claw modifiers.    Serpent Strike Increases the damage of Instant Poison by 3% and the periodic damage of Deadly Poison by 5%. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Serpent Venom
Description: Finishing move that poisons the target, dealing Stormstrike damage per combo point:     1 point  : 27 damage over 12 sec     2 points: 42 damage over 12 sec     3 points: 57 damage over 12 sec     4 points: 72 damage over 12 sec     5 points: 87 damage over 12 sec       This uses Rip modifiers.

Name: Sever
Description: This spell belongs to Reaper    Attempt to drain an enemy's vitals, leeching 30 health, interrupting casting and preventing any spell from that school from being cast for 3 sec.

Name: Shadesinger Shot
Description: You attempt to finish the wounded target off, firing a ranged attack dealing 150% weapon damage plus 48 Shadowstrike damage. Shadesinger Shot can only be used on enemies that have 20% or less health.  This uses Kill Shot modifiers.

Name: Shadow Artillery
Description: Launch Shadow Artillery at the target's location, dealing 87 plus 138 over 6 seconds Shadow damage to nearby enemies.    Max 2 charges. 15 second recharge timer.

Name: Shadow Blades
Description: Draws upon surrounding shadows to empower your weapons, causing your direct damaging rogue melee combo point generating abilities to generate 1 additional combo point and deal additional 50 Shadow damage for 15 sec.    Shadow Blades can only trigger once per ability cast.

Name: Shadow Counter

Name: Shadow Counter

Name: Shadow Dagger
Description: Throw a shadowy dagger that bounces to 4 nearby enemies dealing 50% weapon damage as Shadow and an additional 18 Shadow damage every 3 seconds for 15 sec.

Name: Shadow Mend
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Wraps an ally in shadows, healing them for 34 health every 1.00 sec over 3 sec.    Usable while in Shadowform.

Name: Shadow Missiles
Description: Launches Shadowstorm Missiles at the enemy, dealing 24 Spellshadow damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.    This uses Arcane Missiles modifiers.

Name: Shadow Rupture
Description: Finishing move that causes Shadowstrike damage over time. Name: Shadow Sever
Description: A vicious strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike plus 36 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.  This uses Mortal Strike modifiers. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Shadow Shot
Description: A shadow shot that causes 50% weapon damage. Causes an additional 5 Shadow damage to slowed targets.    Triggers Corruption if known.    This uses Steady Shot modifiers.

Name: Shadow Siphon
Description: A deadly attack that deals 50% weapon damage as Shadowstrike plus 11 and heals you for 5% of your maximum health for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Death Strike modifiers.

Name: Shadow Slam
Description: Slams the opponent with shadow force, causing 65% weapon damage plus 6 Shadowstrike damage.    This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Shadow Slash
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 as Shadowstrike damage and causes a high amount of threat.    This uses Heroic Strike modifiers.

Name: Shadow Smash
Description: Smashes a target for 98% weapon damage as Shadow damage, increasing your Shadow and Physical damage dealt to the target by 5% for 10 sec.    This uses Colossus Smash modifiers.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Shadow Swipe (Bear)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 12 Shadowstrike damage plus 1 Shadowstrike damage.  This uses Swipe modifiers.

Name: Shadow Swipe (Cat)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 90% weapon damage as Shadowstrike.  This uses Swipe modifiers.

Name: Shadow Talon
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 5 as Shadowstrike damage.    This uses Raptor Strike modifiers.

Name: Shadow Waste Bolt

Name: Shadow Word: Gore
Description: A word of gory darkness that causes your target to bleed for 7 Shadow damage, increased by 8% (up to 40%) per bleed you have applied to the target. Lasts 18 sec.    This uses Shadow Word: Pain modifiers.

Name: Shadowcrawl
Description: This spell belongs to Venomancer    For 15 sec, all periodic damage dealt now has a 30% chance to burst dealing 10% of its damage as Shadow damage to 8 enemies within 8 yds.    Usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Shadowed Riposte
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 100% weapon damage as Shadowstrike and slows their melee attack speed by 20% for 30 sec. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Riposte modifiers.

Name: Shadowpierce

Name: Shadowy Bloodstrike

Description: While active, critical strikes with Sinister Strike and Eviscerate trigger Ice Lance, if known. Manually cast Ice Lance critical strikes restore 40 energy over 8 sec.    Finishing move that boosts melee attack speed by 20%. Duration increases with combo points:     1 point  : 9 seconds     2 points: 12 seconds     3 points: 15 seconds     4 points: 18 seconds     5 points: 21 seconds    Uses Slice and Dice modifiers. Requires a single Two-Handed Melee Weapon.

Name: Slither
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Transform into a serpent, removing all movement impairing effects and increasing movement speed by 80% for 5 sec.  You cannot attack or cast spells, but chance to be hit by ranged attacks and spells is reduced by 100% for the duration.

Name: Snapseed
Description: This spell belongs to Ranger    Toss a snapseed at an enemy, dealing 37 Physical damage and knocking them back.

Name: Snatch
Description: This spell belongs to Ranger    Snatch an enemy's melee weapons, disarming them for 4 sec.    If you are disarmed, you also return your weapon to yourself.

Name: Snowshred
Description: Shred the target, causing 145% weapon damage plus 15 as Froststrike damage to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point. Effects which increase bleed damage also increase Snowshred damage.    This uses Shred modifiers.

Name: Solar Nova
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Emit a powerful holy light in an 8 yd radius, dealing 94 Holy damage to all nearby enemies.     This ability is guaranteed to critically strike against Undead or Demons.

Name: Solar Strike
Description: Finishing move that has a 20% chance per combo point to apply Solar Burn and deals Spellstorm damage per combo point:     1 point  : 6-8 damage     2 points: 10-12 damage     3 points: 13-15 damage     4 points: 17-19 damage     5 points: 21-23 damage    This uses Eviscerate modifiers.    Solar Burn Burns the enemy for 1 Spellstorm damage every 3 seconds for 9 sec.

Name: Soul Reaper
Description: Afflicts the target for 18 sec, dealing 25 Shadowfrost damage every 3 sec.     While the target is below 35% health, ticks deal tripple damage.     If the target is below 35% health when Soul Reaper expires, it bursts and increases your 15% melee, ranged, and spell casting speed for 5 sec.

Name: Spartan Kick
Description: A mighty kick that knocks your target back and deals 13 physical damage.    THIS IS SPARTA!

Name: Spectral Warden
Description: This spell belongs to Reaper    Summon a spectral guardian to fight alongside you for 20 sec and apply an absorption shield to up to 8 allies within 20 yds, absorbing 235 damage.

Name: Speed Rune
Description: This spell belongs to Runemaster    Conjure a path of runes in the direction you are facing for 10 sec, increasing the movement speed of allies by 70%.    This effect can persist for a short duration after leaving the runic path.

Name: Spellbound Cleave
Description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 9 as Spellstrike damage to the target and his nearest ally.    This uses Cleave modifiers.

Name: Spellfang Bite
Description: Finishing move that deals Arcane damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy (up to a maximum of 30 extra energy) into 0.7 additional damage:      1 point  : 13-16 damage      2 points: 21-24 damage      3 points: 30-33 damage      4 points: 38-41 damage      5 points: 47-50 damage    This uses Ferocious Bite modifiers.

Name: Spellwave
Description: Sends a wave of force in front of the caster, causing 4 Spellstrike damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets in a frontal cone for 4 sec.  This uses Shockwave modifiers.

Name: Spiked Reinforcement
Description: This spell belongs to Guardian    Reinforce your shield with spikes, causing your blocks to deal 3 Physical damage to the attacker. Lasts 1 hour.

Name: Spirit Charge
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Charge to an ally's aid, healing them for 53 and dealing 67 Nature damage to enemies within 5 yds of them.

Name: Spirit of the Forest
Description: Imbues you with the Spirit of the Forest for 20 sec. Wild Growth heals twice as many targets, Lifebloom now applies with 3 stacks and Rejuvenation now instantly heals your ally for 3.

Name: Spite
Description: This spell belongs to Barbarian    Quickly unleash 3 ranged attacks at your target and then fling yourself back a great distance, dealing 150% Ranged Weapon Damage.

Name: Spore
Description: This spell belongs to Venomancer    Inject an enemy with parasitic spores, dealing 15 Shadow damage, plus an additional 84 to 98 over 21 sec.    After 10 sec, drop a Mushroom below the target that explodes after 2 sec, dealing 2 Nature damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Staggering Shout
Description: Causes all enemies within 10 yards to become rooted for 3 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Stampede
Description: Summon a herd of stampeding animals from the wilds around you that deal Physical damage to your enemies over 6 sec. The animals run up to 30 yards in front of you.    Enemies struck by the stampede take increased damage from your pet by 5% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 4 times. Enemies struck also have their movement speed reduced by 50% for 3 sec.    Damage is increased by 50% if Bestial Wrath is active on your pet.    The cooldown of Stampede is reduced by the Longevity talent.

Name: Starburst
Description: Channel rapid Arcane Explosions in the area, dealing 29 Arcane damage every 0.5 sec. Damage increases by 100% each tick.    Casting damaging spells increases the channel duration by 0.5 sec, up to 1.5 sec.    Scales with Arcane Explosion Modifiers.

Name: Starcall
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller    Smash up to 8 enemies, dealing 4 Arcane damage, scaling with block value, and reducing their attack speed by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Starshatter
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller    Call down the power of the stars, sending forth Elune's astral light in a line outward from you, stunning enemies struck for 5 sec.

Name: Stone Shard
Description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, dealing 24 Physical damage.     This uses Earth Shock modifiers.

Name: Storm Breaker
Description: Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect. In addition, causes 78% weapon damage (62% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 3 as Stormstrike damage for each application of Sunder Armor on the target. The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 5 times.    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.    This uses Devastate modifiers.

Name: Storm Counter
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 32 Stormstrike damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec.  This uses Counterattack modifiers. Storm Counter cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Name: Storm Mangle
Description: Mangle the target, inflicting Stormstrike damage and causing the target to take 30% additional damage from bleeds for 1 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability can be used in Cat Form or Dire Bear Form. This uses Mangle modifiers.

Name: Storm Maul
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 18 as Stormstrike damage and causes a high amount of threat. Effects which increase bleed effects also increase Maul damage.    This uses Maul modifiers.

Name: Storm Multi-Shot
Description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike.  This uses Multi-Shot modifiers.

Name: Storm Rake
Description: Rake the target for 7 Stormstrike damage and an additional 65 Stormstrike damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.    This uses Rake modifiers.

Name: Storm Revenge
Description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 58 to 70 Stormstrike damage. Storming Vengeance is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.  This uses Revenge modifiers.

Name: Storm Sever
Description: A vicious strike that deals 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 36 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.  This uses Mortal Strike modifiers. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Storm Siphon
Description: A deadly attack that deals 50% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 11 and heals you for 5% of your maximum health for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Death Strike modifiers.

Name: Storm Slam
Description: Slams the opponent, causing 65% weapon damage plus 6 Stormstrike damage.    This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Storm Smash
Description: Smash the ground dealing 22 Physical damage to nearby enemies and increasing the time between attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.

Name: Storm Spree
Description: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy for 85% weapon damage as Stormstrike every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made. Can hit the same target multiple times. Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.  This uses Killing Spree modifiers.

Name: Storm Swipe (Bear)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 12 Stormstrike damage plus 1 Stormstrike damage.  This uses Swipe modifiers.

Name: Storm Swipe (Cat)
Description: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 90% weapon damage as Stormstrike.  This uses Swipe modifiers.

Name: Storm Talon
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 5 as Stormstrike damage.    This uses Raptor Strike modifiers.

Name: Stormbound Cleave
Description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 9 as Stormstrike damage to the target and his nearest ally.    This uses Cleave modifiers.

Name: Stormbound Shot
Description: An aimed shot that deals 100% weapon damage plus 12 as Stormstrike damage and reduces healing done to that target by 50%. Lasts 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This uses Aimed Shot modifiers.

Name: Stormchaser
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike damage. Only usable after the target dodges. Stormchaser cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.    This uses Overpower modifiers.

Name: Stormcloak

Name: Stormhammer
Description: Throw a Lightning infused hammer at the target, dealing 163 Nature damage. Causes a high amount of threat.    This uses Concussion Blow modifiers.

Name: Storming Execution

Name: Stormpierce

Name: Summon Void Zone

Name: Sun Down
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Bring the wrath of the sun down upon an enemy after 2 sec, dealing 352 Holyflame Damage and scorching the earth beneath them for 9 sec.    While inside, enemies are struck by a Solar Flare every 3 sec.  Solar Flare Deals 40 Holyflame Damage and reduces the target's chance to hit by 3% for 10 sec.

Name: Sun Gate
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Shift 25 yds forward at light speed, removing all root effects.    This leaves behind a Sun Gate for 15 sec that allies can interact with to blink themselves the same distance forward. Allies can only use |CffffffffSun Gate|r every 1.50 min.

Name: Sunburst
Description: Deals 101 Nature damage to the target and 4 enemies within 5 yards.    This uses Starsurge modifiers.

Name: Sunder Soul
Description: Sunders the target's soul, dealing 65% Shadowstrike weapon damage (52% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 3 and increases your spell critical strike chance against the target by 3%. Stacks 5 times and lasts for 15 sec.    This uses Devastate modifiers.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Sunfire
Description: Burns your target and 4 additional targets within 8 yards, dealing 9 to 12 Firestorm damage and 30 additional damage over 15 sec.

Name: Sunwell
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Become an embodiment of the sun for 30 sec, periodically dispelling fear, sleep, and charm effects every 3 sec from allies within 40 yds.

Name: Surging Tonic
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a bitter tonic, increasing your haste by 15% and reducing the cost of all abilities by 20% for 15 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Survival Potion
Description: This spell belongs to Ranger    Drink a survival potion, immediately dispelling all poison and disease effects. Every 3 sec for 9 sec, heal for 10% of your maximum health and remove one additional poison and disease effect.

Name: Synchronize

Max 2 charges. 6 second recharge timer.    Casting Synchronize consumes 70 energy, if Temporal Distortion or Eternity is known.    This uses Arcane Missiles modifiers.

Name: Syndicate Sniper Shot
Description: Fire a shot from Stealth, dealing 205% weapon damage plus 11. Awards 2 combo points.

Description: Blasts nearby enemies dealing 10 Stormstrike damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.    This uses Thunder Clap modifiers.

Name: Templar's Slash
Description: Launch a powerful swing, dealing 300% weapon damage to up to 6 enemies in a cone in front of you.    Max 3 charges, 8 seconds recharge timer.

Name: Temporal Blast
Description: Blasts your target with energy, dealing 143 Arcane damage.    If canceled early, your next Temporal Blast is reduced by the time spent casting.    Casting this increases all Arcane damage by 15% and its mana cost by 150%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 6 sec. Removed if you cast another Arcane ability that deals damage.    This uses Arcane Blast modifiers.

Name: Temporal Rift
Description: Create a temporal rift that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing 43 to 50 Arcane damage to enemies within 10 yards.     Max 3 charges. 10 seconds recharge timer.    This uses Arcane Explosion modifiers.

Name: Temporal Shield
Description: Envelops you in a temporal shield for 4 sec. If the shield lasts its full duration, 75% of the damage taken is instantly restored.

Name: Testament of Fortitude
Description: This spell belongs to Templar    Meditate for 15 sec, restoring 5% of your base health every 1 sec and reducing damage taken by 20%.    Each second you will also remove 1 disease effect from yourself.

Name: The Eye of the Storm
Description: This spell belongs to Stormbringer    Mark an enemy for 4 sec. Every 1 sec, enemies near them take 21 Nature damage.    At the end of the duration, enemies near them also take 70 Nature damage and are rooted for 4 sec.

Name: Thief of Fate
Description: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. Stolen effects last a maximum of 2 min.    Does not break stealth.    This uses Pick Pocket modifiers.

Name: Thrash (Bear)
Description: Deals 9 damage, and causes all targets within 8 yards to bleed for 2 damage over 10 sec sec, this bleed can stack up to 5 times.    This ability scales with modifiers to Swipe (Bear).

Name: Throw Weapon
Description: Throws your weapon, inflicting 100% weapon damage and stunning the target for 1 second. Disarms you for 2 sec.

Name: Thrust
Description: An instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to 100% of your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point and ignores 20% of the armor.    This uses Sinister Strike modifiers.

Name: Thunder Hide
Description: The caster's fur becomes electrically charged, reducing damage taken from creatures by 5%.    When hit by a spell, melee, or ranged attack, the attacker is struck for 13 Nature damage. This consumes a charge of Thunder Hide and lasts 10 min.    This uses Lightning Shield modifiers. This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Thunder Slam
Description: Slams up to 5 nearby opponents, causing 45% Nature weapon damage plus 26 Nature damage within a 10-yard frontal cone.     This uses Slam modifiers.

Name: Thundering Bloodstrike
Description: Instantly strike the enemy, causing 25% weapon damage as Stormstrike plus 8, total damage increased by 12.5% for each of your diseases on the target.  This uses Blood Strike modifiers.

Name: Thundering Riposte
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 100% weapon damage as Stormstrike and slows their melee attack speed by 20% for 30 sec. Awards 1 combo point.  This uses Riposte modifiers.

Name: Thunderlizard Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 11 Stormstrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Thunderwave
Description: Sends a wave of force in front of the caster, causing 4 Stormstrike damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets in a frontal cone for 4 sec.  This uses Shockwave modifiers.

Description: Applies a Time Bomb to the enemy that stores 50% of your Arcane damage dealt against the target and detonates it after 10 sec.    Dealing damage with Arcane Barrage decreases the cooldown by 8 seconds.

Name: Time Out!
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Enter a stasis for 6 sec, instantly restoring 15% of your maximum mana and regenerating 5% of your maximum mana every 0.50 sec.  While active, your damage taken is reduced by 50% but any direct damage taken may end the effect.

Name: Time Warp
Description: Returns you to your active Temporal Anomaly.    While you know this spell casting Blink leaves behind a Temporal Anomaly.

Name: Time-bind
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Creates a bond with Eternity with your ally. After 6 sec, it applies a periodic heal, restoring 30% of the damage taken during the bond. This effect is increased by healing power.    Casting Time-bind consumes 30 energy, if Temporal Distortion or Eternity is known.    Duration cannot be extended.    Only one target can be affected by Time-bind at a time.    This uses Renew modifiers.

Name: Timeguard
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Place a magical guard on an ally for 2 min, causing the next 3 instances of direct damage that would reduce the target below 35% health to deal 40% less damage.

Name: Titanic Mutilate

Name: Touch of Elune

Name: Tranquil Circle

Name: Trap Launcher: Immolation Trap

Name: Tree of Wrath
Description: Grants the ability to shapeshift into the Tree of Wrath, freeing you from all movement impairing effects.    While active, you increase your party and raid's healing received by 6%.    In this form, you can only cast healing spells, Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning, and their chance to hit is increased by 100%.    Tree of Wrath reduces the mana cost of your Druid healing over time spells by 20%.

Name: Twilight Shieldtoss
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Hurl a cursed shield, dealing 90 Shadow damage to up to 3 enemies, reduced by 20% with each jump.

Name: Twilight Shock
Description: Instantly blasts the target for 132 Twilight damage and causes the target to take 9 damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec.    This uses Shadowburn modifiers.

Name: Twisted Seal
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Create a warped sigil that bends hostile force away from you, deflecting all spells for 5 sec, but making you unable to attack or cast spells.    Casters whose magic is deflected are silenced for 3 sec.

Name: Unchained Blink

Name: Unrelenting Wrath
Description: Send your Tamed Pet into a rage for 8 sec causing 30% additional damage, reducing its threat generated by 15%, and resetting the cooldown of your Frenzy Shot.    Max 2 charges. 2 minute recharge timer. Bestial Assault rapidly restores charges.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.    Will trigger a lesser version of Beast Within if any rank is known, you are not immune to crowd control effects during this.

Name: Unstable Chronoglass
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Place an Unstable Chronoglass at target location for 30 sec that will redirect the next 3 enemy spell casts onto itself.

Name: Unstable Evocation

Name: Upheaval

Name: Valkyr's Calling
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Target an enemy and leap into the air, becoming immune to all physical attacks and spells for 2 sec.    At the end of the duration, you charge back down, dealing 127 Holy damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

Name: Vampiric Bite
Description: Deals 79 Shadow damage every 3 seconds and increases your chance to critically strike the target by 3%. Lasts 15 sec.    This uses Vampiric Touch modifiers. This periodic damage can critically strike.

Usable while shapeshifted.

Description: Unleash a shadowy onslaught, dealing 632 Shadow damage to 8 enemies.    This uses Seed of Corruption modifiers.

Name: Waves of Time
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Blast enemies in a frontal cone with time fractals, knocking them back slightly.    The knockback repeats 1 additional time after 2 sec.

Name: Weighted Reinforcement
Description: This spell belongs to Guardian    Reinforce your shield with heavy alloys, increasing your attack power by 5%, but reducing your haste by 5%. Lasts 1 hr.

Name: Wendigo Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 11 Froststrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Whirling Aether
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Spellstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Flames
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Firestrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Ice
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Froststrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Light
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Holystrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Shadows
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Shadowstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Whirling Storm
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 65% weapon damage as Stormstrike damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.    This uses Whirlwind modifiers.

Name: Wind Gate
Description: This spell belongs to Stormbringer    Place a Wind Gate at target location for 1 min.     You may cast Wind Gate: Evacuate on an ally to pull them to your Wind Gate.

Name: Winds of Winter
Description: Finishing move that deals Frost damage per combo point to enemies in a cone in front of the caster:     1 point  : 36-57 damage     2 points: 70-91 damage     3 points: 104-125 damage     4 points: 138-159 damage     5 points: 173-194 damage    This uses Cone of Cold modifiers.

Name: Winterfall Firebreath
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 80 to 88 Fire damage and an additional 6 Fire damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec. Enemies hit are slowed by 30%.     This uses Cone of Cold modifiers.  This ability can be used while shapeshifted.

Name: Witchblood Tonic
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Drink a shadowy tonic, removing all curse effects from you and reducing all Magic damage taken by 40% for 10 sec.    Shares a cooldown with other Tonics.

Name: Worgen Form
Description: Transform into a Worgen, increasing melee attack power by 1 plus 25% of Agility, allowing the use of Cat Form and Shadow Priest abilities.     Grants Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch the ability to benefit from haste.    Direct Shadow damage reduces the cooldown of Goldrinn's Fury by 2 seconds.

Name: Worthy Sacrifice
Description: This spell belongs to Bloodmage    Instantly generate 50 Rage.

Name: Wraith
Description: Finishing move that haunts your target, dealing damage and increasing the damage of your Physical damage-over-time effects against it.   When Wraith ends or is dispelled, it heals you for 100% of the direct damage done.    1 point : 111 Physical damage; 2% increase for 12 sec    2 points: 191 Physical damage; 4% increase for 12 sec    3 points: 270 Physical damage; 6% increase for 12 sec    4 points: 350 Physical damage; 8% increase for 12 sec    5 points: 430 Physical damage; 10% increase for 12 sec    This uses Haunt modifiers.

Name: Wyrm Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 11 Spellstrike damage.    This uses Mongoose Bite modifiers.

Name: Xorothian Sigil
Description: This spell belongs to Knight of Xoroth    Create a demonic sigil that protects party members within 20 yds of you, causing them to deflect the next harmful spell cast against them within 3 sec.

Name: Zandalari Glaive
Description: Hurl two glaives toward the target, each dealing 150% melee weapon damage.    This uses Glaive Toss modifiers and shares a cooldown with Glaive Toss.

Name: Zulian Guardian
Description: Summons two prowling Zulian Guardians for 20 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    This uses Feral Spirits modifiers.

Name: Aspect of the Beast
Description: Take on the Aspects of a Beast, becoming untrackable and increasing melee attack power by 10% for you and your pet.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Cheetah
Description: You take on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%.  If struck, you will be dazed for 4 sec.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Dragonhawk
Description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a dragonhawk, increasing ranged attack power by 120 and chance to dodge by 10%.    Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Hawk
Description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing ranged attack power by 11.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Monkey
Description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 10%.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Pack
Description: The hunter and raid members within 40 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%.      If you are struck under the effect of this aspect, you will be dazed for 4 sec.    Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Viper
Description: The hunter takes on the aspect of the viper, causing ranged and melee attacks a chance to regenerate mana.    Damage and healing done reduced by 40%.     You gain 4% of maximum mana every 3 sec.   Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Aspect of the Wild
Description: The hunter, group and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 45.      Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

Name: Barbed Shot
Description: Fire a shot that tears through your enemy, causing them to bleed over 8 sec.    Sends your pet into a bloodrush, increasing attack speed by 20% for 8 sec, stacking up to 3 times.    Max 2 charges. 12 second recharge timer.

Name: Beast Mastery
Description: Requires  Tame Beast Abilities  You master the art of Beast training, teaching you the ability to tame Exotic pets and increasing your total amount of Pet Skill Points by 6.

Name: Bestial Wrath
Description: Send your tamed beast or tamed dragonkin into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 10 sec.  While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.  Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Call Stabled Pet
Description: Choose one of your stabled pets to replace your current pet. The selected pet busts out of its stable to join you no matter where you are.  Cannot be used in combat.

Name: Eyes of the Beast
Description: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 1 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Frenzy Shot
Description: Fires a shot, dealing 150% weapon damage. This sends your pet into a frenzy, causing its auto attacks to trigger an additional attack that strikes up to 5 nearby enemies for 8 sec.

Name: Intimidation
Description: Command your tamed beast to intimidate the target, causing a high amount of threat and stunning the target for 3 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Kill Command
Description: Give the command to kill, increasing your tamed beast's damage done from special attacks by 40% for 30 sec. Each special attack done by the tamed beast reduces the damage bonus by 10%.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Master's Call
Description: Your pet attempts to remove all root and movement impairing effects from itself and its owner, and causes your pet and its target to be immune to all such effects for 4 sec.

Name: Mend Pet
Description: Heals your Tamed Pet for 125 health over 15 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.  Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Scare Beast
Description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Tame Beast Abilities
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to tame a pet companion.  Teaches you Tame Beast, Call Pet, Dismiss Pet, Feed Pet, Revive Pet and Beast Lore.

Name: Aimed Shot
Description: An aimed shot that deals 150% weapon damage plus 5 and reduces healing done to that target by 50%. Lasts 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Arcane Shot
Description: An instant shot that causes 15 Arcane damage.

Name: Auto shot
Description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled. Increases your ranged Attack Speed by 33% and scales with Ranged Attack Power.

Name: Chimera Shot
Description: Deals 230% ranged weapon damage, refreshing the current Stings on your target and triggering extra effects if the Stings are active:  Serpent Sting - Instantly deals 90% of the damage done by your Serpent Sting.  Viper Sting - Instantly restores mana to you equal to 60% of the total amount drained by your Viper Sting.   Scorpid Sting - Disarms the target for 10 sec. This effect cannot occur more than once per 1 minute.

Name: Concussive Shot
Description: A shot that deals 90% weapon damage and dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

Name: Distracting Shot
Description: Distracts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you. Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Flare
Description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 20 sec.

Name: Hunter's Mark
Description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the ranged attack power of all attackers against that target by 20.    The marked target can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible, and appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 5 min.

Name: Kill Shot
Description: You attempt to finish the wounded target off, firing a ranged attack dealing 200% weapon damage plus 26. Kill Shot can only be used on enemies that have 20% or less health.

Name: Multi-Shot
Description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets for 100% weapon damage.

Name: Rapid Fire
Description: Increases ranged attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

Name: Readiness
Description: When activated, this ability immediately resets the cooldown on your other Hunter abilities except Bestial Wrath.

Name: Scorpid Sting
Description: Stings the target, reducing chance to hit with melee and ranged attacks by 3% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Serpent Sting
Description: Stings the target, causing 25 Nature damage over 15 sec.

Name: Silencing Shot
Description: A shot that deals 75% weapon damage and silences the target for 2 sec. Non-player victim spellcasting is also interrupted for 3 sec.     Silencing Shot cannot trigger any procs.    This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Steady Shot
Description: A steady shot that causes 75% weapon damage plus 9. Causes an additional 10 to slowed targets.

Name: Tranquilizing Shot
Description: Attempts to remove 1 Enrage and 1 Magic effect from an enemy target.

Name: Trueshot Aura
Description: Increases the attack power of all party and raid members by 10% within 100 yards.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Viper Sting
Description: Stings the target, draining 4% mana over 8 sec (up to a maximum of 8% of the caster's maximum mana), and energizing you equal to the amount drained. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

Name: Volley
Description: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 55 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1.00 second for 6 sec.

Name: Black Arrow
Description: Fires a Black Arrow at the target, increasing all damage done by you to the target by 6% and dealing 94 Shadow damage every 3 over 15 sec.

Name: Counterattack
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 48 damage and immobilizes the target for 5 sec.     Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Name: Deterrence
Description: When activated, increases parry chance by 100%, reduces the chance ranged attacks will hit you by 100% and grants a 100% chance to deflect spells.  While Deterrence is active, you cannot attack.  Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Disengage
Description: You attempt to disengage from combat, leaping backwards.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Explosive Shot
Description: You fire an explosive charge into the enemy target, dealing 34 Fire damage to the target.    Nearby enemies are also hit, for 40% of damage dealt.     The charge will blast the target every second for an additional 2 sec.

Name: Explosive Trap
Description: Place a fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 109 to 139 Fire damage and burning all enemies for 181 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Feign Death
Description: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Raid Bosses will see through this trick, but staying feigned will deceive them. Lasts up to 6 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Freezing Arrow
Description: Fire a freezing arrow that places a Freezing Trap at the target location, freezing the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec.  Any damage caused will break the ice.  Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Freezing Trap
Description: Place a frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 10 sec.(8 seconds against players).    Any damage caused will break the ice.   Trap will exist for 30 sec.   Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Frost Trap
Description: Place a frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 50% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Glaive Toss
Description: You hurl two glaives toward the target, each dealing 75% weapon damage.

Name: Immolation Trap
Description: Place a fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 139 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Misdirection
Description: The current party or raid member targeted will receive the threat caused by your spells and attacks for 6 sec afterwards.

Name: Mongoose Bite
Description: Attack the enemy for 16 damage.

Name: Raptor Strike
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 5.

Name: Scatter Shot
Description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec.  Any damage caused except for Piercing Shots and Serpent Sting will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

Name: Snake Trap
Description: Place a trap that will release several venomous snakes to attack the first enemy to approach. The snakes will die after 15 sec. Trap will exist for 30 sec. Only one trap can be active at a time.

Name: Track Beasts
Description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap and increases damage dealt to beasts by 1%.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Demons
Description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap and increases damage dealt to demons by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Dragonkin
Description: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap and increases damage dealt to dragonkin by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Elementals
Description: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap and increases damage dealt to elementals by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Giants
Description: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap and increases damage dealt to giants by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Hidden
Description: Greatly increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap.     Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Humanoids
Description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Track Undead
Description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap and increases damage dealts to undead by 1%. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Tracking Mastery
Description: You gain Tracking Mastery when learning any Tracking Ability.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Tracking Abilities when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.    Track Beasts Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap and increases damage dealt to beasts by 1%.    Track Humanoids Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.    Track Undead Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap and increases damage dealts to undead by 1%.    Track Elementals Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap and increases damage dealt to elementals by 1%.    Track Demons Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap and increases damage dealt to demons by 1%.    Track Giants Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap and increases damage dealt to giants by 1%.    Track Dragonkin Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap and increases damage dealt to dragonkin by 1%.    Track Hidden Greatly increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap.     Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

Name: Wing Clip
Description: Maims the enemy, dealing 16 damage and reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

Name: Wyvern Sting
Description: A stinging shot that puts the target to sleep for 30 sec. (6 seconds against players) Any damage will cancel the effect.  When the target wakes up, the Sting causes 300 Nature damage over 6 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on the target at a time.

Name: Alter Time
Description: Alter the fabric of time, causing the caster to return to their current location, their health and mana, when cast a second time, or after 4 sec. Any self-applied, magic dispellable effects are also returned to their previous state.  Effect negated if the caster dies within the 4 sec or before the effect occurs, or moves too far away.

Name: Amplify Magic
Description: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing magic damage taken by 5% and healing spells by 5%.  Lasts 10 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Arcane Barrage
Description: Launches several missiles at the enemy target, causing 251 to 306 Arcane damage.

Name: Arcane Blast
Description: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 155 to 179 Arcane damage.      Casting this increases all Arcane damage by 15% and its mana cost by 150%. Stacks up to 4 and lasts 6 sec, removed if you cast another Arcane ability that deals damage.

Name: Arcane Explosion
Description: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 28 to 32 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

Name: Arcane Intellect
Description: Increases the target's Intellect by 2 and spell power by 2 for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Arcane Missiles
Description: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 17 Arcane damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

Name: Arcane Orb
Description: Launches an Arcane Orb forward from your position, traveling up to 35 yards, dealing 336 Arcane damage every 0.5 sec to enemies it passes through and increasing their Arcane damage taken from you by 10%.     Subsequent hits on the same target deals 50% less damage.

Name: Arcane Power
Description: When activated, your spells and abilities deal 20% more magic damage while costing 20% more mana to cast.  This effect lasts 15 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability can be used while in Cat, Bear, Moonkin or Tree of Life Shapeshifts.

Name: Arcane Ward
Description: Absorbs 165 Arcane damage. Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Blink
Description: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way.  Also frees the caster from stuns and bonds.

Name: Brilliance Aura
Description: Restores 2% missing mana every 1 second to all party members within 35 yards for 15 sec.

Name: Conjure Food
Description: Conjures 10 muffins, providing the mage and her allies with something to eat.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Name: Conjure Mana Gem
Description: Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 314 to 337 mana. 3 charges.

Name: Conjure Refreshment
Description: Conjures 20 Mana Berries providing the mage and her allies with something to eat.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Name: Conjure Water
Description: Conjures 10 bottles of water, providing the mage and her allies with something to drink.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Name: Counterspell
Description: Counters the enemy's spell cast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 8 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.     This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Dampen Magic
Description: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing magic damage taken by 5% and healing spells by 5%.  Lasts 10 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Dispel Curse
Description: Removes 1 Curse from a friendly target.

Name: Evocation
Description: While channeling this spell, you gain 60% of your total mana over 8 sec.

Name: Focus Magic
Description: Increases the target's chance to critically hit with spells by 3%.      When the target critically hits the caster's chance to critically hit with spells is increased by 3% for 10 sec.     Cannot be cast on self.

Name: Invisibility
Description: Fades the caster to invisibility over 3 sec, reducing threat each second. While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible. Lasts 20 sec.

Name: Invocation
Description: Channel potent energies, reducing damage taken by 35% and periodically discharging projectiles of raw mana that deal high-threat Magic damage to nearby enemies. Lasts 4 seconds.    When the channel ends, 30% of the damage taken during Invocation is restored as mana over 10 sec.    While channeling you are immune to Stun effects.

Name: Mage Armor
Description: Increases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Lasts until cancelled.    Only one type of Mage Armor spell can be active at any time.

Name: Mana Shield
Description: Absorbs 120 damage, draining mana instead. Drains 1.5 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.

Name: Mana-forged Barrier
Description: Your threat generated is significantly increased.    Teaches you Channeled Mana.      Channeled Mana 2 Mana Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.    This spell is learned when you have a Tank Stance and cannot be unlearned.

Name: Mass Invisibility
Description: You and your allies within 40 yards instantly become invisible for 5 sec. The effect is cancelled if you perform any actions. While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible. Removes invulnerabilities when used.

Name: Mirror Image
Description: Creates 3 copies of the caster nearby, which cast spells and attack the mage's enemies.  Lasts 30 sec.

Name: Polymorph
Description: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly.      Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form.     Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.    8 second duration on players

Name: Portal Mastery
Description: Gives the ability to learn Portal and Teleport spells.  You can learn the various Teleports and Portals in many towns and cities!

Name: Presence of Mind
Description: When activated, your next damaging spell within 10 sec with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes instant.

Name: Ritual of Refreshment
Description: Begins a ritual to create a refreshment table. Raid members can click to receive Conjured Mana Berries.     Requires the caster and 2 others to complete. Participants must right-click the portal and remain still.    Lasts 3 min or 50 charges.

Name: Slow Fall
Description: Slows friendly party or raid target's falling speed for 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Slow
Description: Reduces target's movement speed by 60%, increases the time between ranged attacks by 60% and increases casting time by 30%.  Lasts 15 sec(10 versus players) Slow can only affect one target at a time.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Spellsteal
Description: Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target.  This effect lasts a maximum of 2 min.

Name: Blast Wave
Description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 76 to 88 Fire damage, knocking them back and dazing them for 6 sec.

Name: Combustion
Description: When activated, this spell increases your critical strike damage bonus with Fire damage spells and abilities by 50%, and causes each of your damaging Fire hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage by 10%.  This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic Fire critical strikes.

Name: Dragon's Breath
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 170 to 207 Fire damage and are Disoriented for 5 sec.  Any direct damaging attack will revive targets.  Turns off your attack when used.

Name: Fire Blast
Description: Blasts the enemy for 19 to 23 Fire damage.

Name: Fire Ward
Description: Absorbs 165 Fire damage.  Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fireball
Description: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 14 to 22 Fire damage and an additional 2 Fire damage over 4 sec.

Name: Flamestrike
Description: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 52 to 68 Fire damage and an additional 48 Fire damage over 8 sec.

Name: Living Bomb
Description: The target becomes a Living Bomb, taking 256 Fire damage over 12 sec.  After 12 sec or when the spell is dispelled, the target explodes dealing 120 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yards.

Name: Meteor
Description: Calls down a meteor which lands at the target location after 3 seconds, dealing 142 Fire damage within 8 yards, and burns the ground for 154 Fire damage over 6 sec to all enemies in the area.

Name: Molten Armor
Description: Causes 40 Fire damage when hit.    Increases your critical strike rating by 10% of your Spirit.    Reduces the chance you are critically hit by 5%.      Lasts until cancelled.    Only one type of Mage Armor spell can be active at any time.

Name: Pyroblast
Description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 133 to 176 Fire damage and an additional 52 Fire damage over 12 sec.

Name: Scorch
Description: Scorch the enemy for 53 to 65 Fire damage.

Name: Tame Dragonkin
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to tame a Dragonkin companion.  Teaches you Tame Dragonkin, Call Dragonkin, Dismiss Dragonkin, Revive Dragonkin and Dragonkin Lore.      Tame Dragonkin Begins taming a dragonkin to be your companion.    Your armor is reduced by 10% while you focus for 20 sec.    If you lose the dragonkin's attention, the taming process will fail.

Name: Blizzard
Description: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 288 Frost damage over 8 sec.

Name: Cold Snap
Description: When activated, this spell resets the cooldown on all Frost spells you recently cast.

Name: Cone of Cold
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 56 to 60 Frost damage and are slowed by 50% for 8 sec.

Name: Deep Freeze
Description: Stuns the target for 5 sec. Only usable on Frozen targets.  Deals 1004 to 1222 damage to monsters permanently immune to stuns.

Name: Frost Armor
Description: Increases Armor by 36.    If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 15% and the time between their attacks increased by 20% for 5 sec.   Lasts until cancelled.    Does not stack with other similar effects. Only one type of Mage armor spell can be active at any time.

Name: Frost Nova
Description: Blasts enemies near the caster for 19 to 21 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec.      Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Frost Ward
Description: Absorbs 165 Frost damage.  Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Frostbolt
Description: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 12 to 15 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 5 sec.

Name: Frostfire Bolt
Description: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 177 to 205 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 18 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists.

Name: Frozen Orb
Description: Launches a Frozen Orb forward from the caster's position, that deals 32 Frost damage to all nearby enemy targets every 1 sec for 8 sec.     Targets damaged by the Frost Orb are slowed by 40% for 2 sec.

Name: Ice Barrier
Description: Instantly shields you, absorbing 369 damage.  Lasts 1 min.  While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be delayed by damage.

Name: Ice Block
Description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all attacks for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move or cast spells.      Causes Hypothermia, preventing you from recasting Ice Block for 30 sec.

Name: Ice Lance
Description: Deals 30 to 33 Frost damage to an enemy target.  Causes triple damage against Frozen targets.

Name: Icy Veins
Description: Hastens your spellcasting, increasing spell casting speed by 20% and reducing the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 100%. Lasts 20 sec.    Does not stack with other similar cast speed increasing effects.

Name: Ring of Frost
Description: Summons a Ring of Frost at the target location. Enemies entering the ring will become frozen for 6 sec. Lasts 8 sec and has an 8 yard radius.

Name: Summon Water Elemental
Description: Summon a Water Elemental to fight for the caster for 45 sec.

Name: Aura Mastery
Description: Causes your Concentration Aura to make all affected targets immune to Silence and Interrupt effects and improve the effect of all other auras by 100%.  Lasts 6 sec.

Name: Beacon of Light
Description: The target becomes a Beacon of Light to all members of your party or raid within a 60 yard radius. Any direct heals you cast on party or raid members will also heal the Beacon for 25% of the amount healed. Lasts 15 sec.     Only one target can be the Beacon of Light at a time.

Name: Blessing of Wisdom
Description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 10 mana every 5 seconds for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Cleanse
Description: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect and 1 magic effect.

Name: Concentration Aura
Description: All party or raid members within 40 yards lose 35% less casting or channeling time when damaged.    Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Consecration
Description: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 34 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.

Name: Divine Favor
Description: When activated, gives your next Holy spell a 100% critical effect chance and 50% increased healing.

Name: Divine Illumination
Description: Reduces resource cost of all magic spells and abilities by 60% and increases the critical effect chance of Holy healing spells by 20% for 15 sec.

Name: Divine Plea
Description: You gain 25% of your total mana over 15 sec, but reduces your healing by 50%.

Name: Exorcism
Description: Causes 99 to 113 Holy damage to an enemy target. Exorcism always critically strikes Undead and Demon targets. It also stuns them for 3 sec.

Name: Flash of Light
Description: Heals a friendly target for 84 to 97.

Name: Holy Light
Description: Heals a friendly target for 31 to 39.

Name: Holy Shock
Description: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 191 to 216 Holy damage to an enemy, or 301 to 327 healing to an ally.

Name: Holy Wrath
Description: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 78 to 90 Holy damage and stunning all Undead and Demon targets within 10 yards for 3 sec.

Name: Lay on Hands
Description: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal of 100% of your maximum health. The target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, Divine Protection or Lay on Hands again for 2 min.    Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

Name: Light of Dawn
Description: Unleashes a wave of Holy energy, healing up to 5 injured allies within a 30 yd frontal cone for 80 to 93.

Name: Light's Hammer
Description: Hurl a Light-infused hammer into the ground, where it will blast a 10 yard area with Arcing Light for 10 sec.  Deals Holy damage to enemies and reduces their movement speed by 50% for 3 sec. Also heals up to 5 allies every 2 sec.

Name: Purify
Description: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

Name: Redemption
Description: Brings a dead player back to life with 65 health and 120 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

Name: Sacred Shield
Description: Each time the target takes damage they gain a Sacred Shield, absorbing 110 damage and increasing the paladin's chance to critically hit with Flash of Light by 50% for up to 6 sec. They cannot gain this effect more than once every 6 sec. Lasts 30 sec.      This spell cannot be on more than one target at any one time.

Name: Seal of Light
Description: Fills you with divine light for until cancelled, giving each melee auto attack a chance to heal you for 0. This effect can only occur once every 2 seconds. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.    Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 3 Holy damage to an enemy.

Name: Seal of Righteousness
Description: Fills you with holy spirit for until cancelled, granting each main hand auto attack and Paladin melee ability 1 additional Holy damage. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 3 Holy damage to an enemy.

Name: Seal of Wisdom
Description: Fills you with divine wisdom for until cancelled, giving each melee auto attack a chance to restore 4% of your total mana. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.    Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 3 Holy damage to an enemy.

Name: Turn Evil
Description: The targeted undead or demon enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 20 sec.      Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.

Name: Avenger's Shield
Description: Hurls a holy shield at the enemy, dealing 441 to 537 Holy damage, Dazing them and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Affects 3 total targets. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Blessing of Kings
Description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 30 min.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Blessing of Sanctuary
Description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, reducing damage taken by 3% and increasing Strength and Stamina by 10% for 30 min.     In addition, when the target blocks, parries, or dodges a melee attack the target will gain 6% of base mana.    Does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Blinding Light
Description: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yards, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec.

Name: Devotion Aura
Description: Gives 40 additional armor to party and raid members within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Divine Intervention
Description: You sacrifice yourself to remove the targeted party member from harm's way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but will not be able to take any action for 3 min.

Name: Divine Protection
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 50% for 12 sec.    Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.    Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Protection, Divine Shield, Hand of Protection or Lay on Hands for 2 min.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Divine Sacrifice
Description: 30% of all damage taken by party members within 30 yards is redirected to the caster (up to a maximum of 40% of the caster's health times the number of party members).  Damage which reduces the caster below 20% health will break the effect.  Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Divine Shield
Description: Protects you from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but reduces your damage by 50%.    Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, Divine Protection or Lay on Hands again for 2 min.

Name: Fire Resistance Aura
Description: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Frost Resistance Aura
Description: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Hammer of Justice
Description: Stuns the target for 3 sec and interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

Name: Hammer of the Righteous
Description: Hammer the current target and up to 2 additional nearby targets, causing 4 times your main hand damage per second as Holy damage.

Name: Hand of Freedom
Description: Places a Hand on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 6 sec.

Name: Hand of Protection
Description: A targeted party or raid member is protected from all physical attacks, Interrupt and Silence mechanics for 6 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. This also removes any Stun effects on use.  Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, Divine Protection or Lay on Hands again for 2 min.    Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

Name: Hand of Sacrifice
Description: Places a Hand on the party or raid member, transferring 30% damage taken to the caster.  Lasts 12 sec or until the caster has transferred 100% of their maximum health.

Name: Hand of Salvation
Description: Places a Hand on the party or raid member, reducing their total threat by 2% every 1 sec. for 10 sec.  Players may only have one Hand on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Holy Shield
Description: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec. Each block expends a charge and deals 50 holy damage to the attacker. 8 charges.

Name: Righteous Defense
Description: Transfers the next melee or ranged attack made against an ally. In addition, while active 20% of the threat they generate is transferred to you instead.  Casting this spell with an enemy target will redirect it to whatever they are targeting.    This cannot be used in Battlegrounds or Arenas

Name: Righteous Fury
Description: Your threat generated is significantly increased.    Teaches you Hand of Reckoning.   Also increases your chance to block Fierce Blows.

Name: Seal of Justice
Description: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for until cancelled, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. This effect has a 10 second cooldown. Only one Seal can be active at any one time.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 3 Holy damage to an enemy.

Name: Shadow Resistance Aura
Description: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Shield of Righteousness
Description: Slam the target with your shield, causing Holy damage based on your block value plus an additional 5. This ability will also heal you based on your spell damage.

Name: Avenging Wrath
Description: Increases all damage and healing caused by 20% for 20 sec.   Cannot be used within 30 sec of being the target of Divine Shield, Divine Protection, or Hand of Protection, or of using Lay on Hands on oneself.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Blessing of Might
Description: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing their Strength and Agility by 2 for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Crusader Aura
Description: Increases the mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.     This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

Name: Crusader Strike
Description: An instant strike that causes 75% weapon damage.

Name: Divine Storm
Description: An instant weapon attack that causes 110% of weapon damage to up to 4 enemies within 8 yards. The Divine Storm heals up to 3 party or raid members for 25% of the damage caused.

Name: Execution Sentence
Description: A hammer slowly falls from the sky, causing Holy damage if the target is an enemy and healing if the target is an ally, over 10 sec.     This culminates in a final burst of damage or healing. Dispelling the effect triggers the final burst.

Name: Hammer of Wrath
Description: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 354 to 390 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

Name: Judgement of Justice
Description: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, preventing them from fleeing and limiting their movement speed.      Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.    Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Name: Judgement of Light
Description: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, granting auto attacks and auto shots made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 2% of their base health.      Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.    Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Name: Judgement of Wisdom
Description: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, giving each attack a chance to restore 2% of the attacker's base mana.     Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.    Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Name: Repentance
