Description: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 1 min (6 seconds on players), and removing the effect of Righteous Vengeance.  Any damage caused will awaken the target. Usable against Demons, Dragonkin, Giants, Humanoids and Undead.

Name: Retribution Aura
Description: Causes 11 Holy damage to any enemy that strikes a party or raid member within 40 yards.      Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Name: Seal of Command
Description: All main hand auto attacks and Paladin melee abilities deal 0 to 1 additional Holy damage to the target and up to 2 additional targets. Lasts until cancelled.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 1 to 2 Holy damage.

Name: Seal of Vengeance
Description: Fills you with holy power, causing main hand auto and Paladin melee abilities to apply Holy Vengeance, which deals 1 additional Holy damage over 15 sec.    Holy Vengeance can stack up to 5 times. Once stacked to 5 times, each of your main hand auto attacks and Paladin melee abilities deals damage as additional Holy damage. Only one Seal can be active on the caster at any one time. Lasts until cancelled.  Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 3 Holy damage to an enemy, increased by 10% for each application of Holy Vengeance on the target.

Name: Angelic Feather
Description: Place a feather at the target location, lasting for 15 sec. If allies walk through it, they gain 50% increased movement speed for 4 sec.  Max 3 charges. 20 second recharge timer.

Name: Dispel Magic
Description: Dispels magic on the target, removing 1 harmful spell from a friend or 1 beneficial spell from an enemy.

Name: Divine Spirit
Description: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 17 for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Fear Ward
Description: Wards the friendly target against Fear and Horror effects. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward.  Lasts 3 min.

Name: Inner Fire
Description: A burst of holy energy fills the caster, increasing armor by 175. Taking melee or ranged damage will remove one stack. Lasts until cancelled or until 20 stacks are used.

Name: Inner Focus
Description: When activated, reduces the mana cost of your next spell or magic ability by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.

Name: Levitate
Description: Allows the friendly party or raid target to levitate, floating a few feet above the ground.  While levitating, the target will fall at a reduced speed and travel over water.  Any damage will cancel the effect.  Lasts 2 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Mana Burn
Description: Destroy 10% of the target's mana (up to a maximum of 20% of your own maximum mana). For each mana destroyed in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

Name: Mass Dispel
Description: Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing 1 harmful spell from each friendly target and 1 beneficial spell from each enemy target.  Affects a maximum of 10 friendly targets and 10 enemy targets.  This dispel is potent enough to remove Magic effects that are normally undispellable, including Divine Shield, Ice Block and Cyclone.    Mass Dispel can remove Stealth from targets within the spell.

Name: Pain Suppression
Description: Instantly reduces a friendly target's threat by 5%, reduces all damage taken by 40% for 8 sec. Pain Suppression has a 60% chance to resist Dispel mechanics.

Name: Penance
Description: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 241 Holy damage to an enemy, or 125 to 141 healing to an ally instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

Name: Power Infusion
Description: Infuses the target with power, increasing spell casting speed by 20% and reducing the cost of all magic spells and abilities by 20%. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Power Word: Fortitude
Description: Power infuses the target, increasing their Stamina by 3 for 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Power Word: Shield
Description: Draws on the soul of the friendly target to shield them, absorbing 44 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

Name: Shackle Undead
Description: Shackles the target undead enemy for up to 30 sec. The shackled unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells.  Any damage caused will release the target.      Only one target can be shackled at a time.

Name: Abolish Disease
Description: Attempts to cure 1 disease effect on the target, and 1 more disease effect every 3 seconds for 12 sec.

Name: Binding Heal
Description: Heals a friendly target and the caster for 359 to 418. Low threat.

Name: Circle of Healing
Description: Heals up to 5 friendly party or raid members within 15 yards of the target for 151 to 173.

Name: Cure Disease
Description: Removes 1 disease from the friendly target.

Name: Desperate Prayer
Description: Heals you for 110 to 150. If used while below 50% health, it guarantees a critical heal.

Name: Divine Hymn
Description: Heals 3 nearby lowest health friendly party or raid targets within 40 yards for 896 to 984 every 2 sec for 8 sec, and increases healing done to them by 10% for 8 sec. Maximum of 12 heals. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

Name: Divine Star
Description: Fires a Divine Star in front of you, traveling 30 yards, healing all allies within 5 yards of its path for 23.  After reaching its destination it will return to its original position, also healing all allies in its path.

Name: Flash Heal
Description: Heals a friendly target for 121 to 146.

Name: Greater Heal
Description: A slow casting spell that heals a single target for 31 to 38.

Name: Guardian Spirit
Description: Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target. The spirit increases the healing received by the target by 40%, and also prevents the target from dying by sacrificing itself, only up to a maximum of 15% of target's total health. This sacrifice terminates the effect but heals the target of 50% of their maximum health. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Halo
Description: Creates a ring of Holy energy around you that quickly expands and grows in power, healing raid and party members up to 30 yds away. Heals with greater effect the further away the ally is. Also increases the Holy healing taken from the caster by 8%.

Name: Holy Fire
Description: Consumes the enemy in holy flames that cause 81 to 97 Holy damage and an additional 21 Holy damage over 7 sec.

Name: Holy Nova
Description: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 21 to 23 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 52 to 60. These effects cause no threat.

Name: Hymn of Hope
Description: Restores 3% mana to 3 nearby low mana friendly party or raid targets every 2 sec for 8 sec, and increases their total maximum mana by 20% for 8 sec. Maximum of 12 mana restores. The Priest must channel to maintain the spell.

Name: Leap of Faith
Description: Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, moving them to you. The same target can only be affected by this once every 30 seconds.

Name: Lightwell
Description: Creates a Holy Lightwell.    Lightwell will attempt to heal a nearby party or raid member within 20 yards every second if they have less than 50% health for 11.    Lightwell lasts for 30 seconds or until it heals 10 times.

Name: Prayer of Healing
Description: A powerful prayer heals the friendly target's party members within 30 yards for 118 to 130.

Name: Prayer of Mending
Description: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 101 the next time they take damage.  When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump.      This spell can only be placed on one target at a time.

Name: Renew
Description: Heals the target for 35 over 15 sec.

Name: Resurrection
Description: Brings a dead player back to life with 70 health and 135 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

Name: Smite
Description: Smite an enemy for 13 to 17 Holy damage.

Name: Devouring Plague
Description: Afflicts the target with a disease that causes 152 Shadow damage over 24 sec. 15% of damage caused by the Devouring Plague heals the caster. This spell can only affect one target at a time.

Name: Dispersion
Description: You disperse into pure Shadow energy, reducing all damage taken by 90%.  You are unable to attack or cast spells, but you regenerate 6% mana every 1 sec for 6 sec. Dispersion can be cast while stunned, feared or silenced and clears all snare and movement impairing effects when cast.

Name: Fade
Description: Fade out, temporarily reducing all your threat for 10 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Mind Blast
Description: Blasts the target for 39 to 43 Shadow damage.

Name: Mind Flay
Description: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 45 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

Name: Mind Sear
Description: Causes an explosion of shadow magic around the enemy target, causing 50 to 57 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec to all enemies within 10 yards around the target.

Name: Mind Soothe
Description: Soothes the target, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid targets. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Mind Vision
Description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Psychic Horror
Description: You terrify the target, causing them to tremble in horror for 3 sec, and disarming their main hand and ranged weapons for 10 sec.  This spell cannot miss.

Name: Psychic Scream
Description: The caster lets out a psychic scream, causing 2 enemies within 8 yards to flee for 6 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Shadow Protection
Description: Increases the target's resistance to Shadow spells by 30 for 30 min.

Name: Shadow Word: Death
Description: A word of dark binding that inflicts 192 to 222 Shadow damage to the target.  If the target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, the caster takes damage equal to the damage inflicted upon the target after a short delay.

Name: Shadow Word: Pain
Description: A word of darkness that causes 30 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

Name: Shadowfiend
Description: Creates a shadowy fiend to attack the target.  Caster receives 5% mana when the Shadowfiend attacks. Damage taken by area of effect attacks is reduced. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Shadowform
Description: Assume a Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 15%.    You may not cast Healing or Priest Holy spells while in this form except for Cure Disease and Abolish Disease.    Grants the periodic damage from your Shadow Word: Pain, Devouring Plague, and Vampiric Touch spells the ability to critically hit and benefit from haste.

Name: Silence
Description: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec. Non-player victim spellcasting is also interrupted for 3 sec.

Name: Vampiric Embrace
Description: Fills you with the embrace of Shadow energy, causing you to be healed for 15% and other party members to be healed for 3% of any single-target Priest Shadow spell damage you deal.     Either heal cannot exceed 5% of the maximum health of the caster.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Vampiric Touch
Description: Causes 340 Shadow damage over 15 sec to your target.     When you deal damage with Mind Blast to a target afflicted by your Vampiric Touch, you gain Replenishment.    If Vampiric Touch is dispelled it will cause 544 damage to the afflicted target.     Replenishment Replenishes 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec on up to 10 party members for 15 sec.

Name: Void Eruption
Description: Releases an explosive blast of pure void energy, causing Shadow damage to up to 10 enemies within 10 yards of your target. The power drawn from the Void increases your periodic Shadow Priest damage by 20% for 5 sec, increased by 0.5 sec for each enemy hit.  While in Shadowform this spell also applies Shadow Word: Pain (if known) to all enemies hit.

Name: Void Shift
Description: You and the currently targeted party or raid member swap health percentages. Increases the health percentage of you and your ally to 25% if below that amount.  After casting or being targeted by Void Shift you cannot cast or be targeted by it for 1 min.

Name: Ambush
Description: Ambush the target, causing 275% weapon damage plus 77 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 2 combo points.

Name: Cheap Shot
Description: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

Name: Cold Blood
Description: When activated, your next direct damage Rogue ability has 100% increased critical strike chance, 20% increased damage (10% versus players) and is usable from 10 yards.     When consumed you will gain 4% melee and ranged critical strike chance for 15 sec.

Name: Combat Readiness
Description: Enter a state of heightened defensive awareness. Each time you're hit by a spell or ability, your overall damage taken is reduced by 5%(3% versus players) for 10 sec. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 20 sec or until you have not been attacked for 10 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Crimson Tempest
Description: Finishing move that slashes at the flesh of all enemies within 8 yards, dealing Physical damage and causing them to bleed per combo point:     1 point: 9 damage and 17 damage over 8 sec     2 points: 16 damage and 25 damage over 8 sec     3 points: 23 damage and 33 damage over 8 sec     4 points: 30 damage and 42 damage over 8 sec     5 points: 38 damage and 51 damage over 8 sec

Name: Deadly Throw
Description: Finishing move that reduces the movement of the target by 50% for 6 sec and causes increased thrown weapon damage:     1 point  : 28-44 damage     2 points: 47-63 damage     3 points: 66-82 damage     4 points: 85-101 damage     5 points: 104-120 damage

Name: Dismantle
Description: Disarm the enemy, removing their weapons, shields, or other equipment carried for 6 sec.

Name: Envenom
Description: Finishing move that consumes your Deadly Poison doses on the target and deals instant poison damage.     After the Envenom attack you have an additional 15% chance to apply Deadly Poison and a 75% increased frequency of applying Instant Poison for 1 sec plus an additional 1 sec per combo point.  One dose is consumed for each combo point:    1 dose:  38 damage    2 doses: 77 damage    3 doses: 116 damage    4 doses: 156 damage    5 doses: 196 damage

Name: Eviscerate
Description: Finishing move that causes damage per combo point:     1 point  : 7-11 damage     2 points: 13-17 damage     3 points: 19-23 damage     4 points: 26-30 damage     5 points: 33-37 damage

Name: Expose Armor
Description: Finishing move that exposes the target, reducing armor by 20% and lasting longer per combo point:    1 point  : 6 sec.    2 points: 12 sec.    3 points: 18 sec.    4 points: 24 sec.    5 points: 30 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Garrote
Description: When attacking from stealth, inflicts 18 damage to an enemy every 3 sec. for 18 sec and silences the enemy for 2 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Hunger For Blood
Description: Enrages you, increasing all Physical and Nature damage caused by 10%, lasting for 15 seconds. Also gives you a movement boost of 30% for 5 seconds. Requires any bleed to be active on the target to be used.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Kidney Shot
Description: Finishing move that stuns the target.  Lasts longer per combo point:    1 point  : 1 second    2 points: 2 seconds    3 points: 3 seconds    4 points: 4 seconds    5 points: 5 seconds

Name: Meditate
Description: Finishing move that consumes combo points on any nearby target to restore 6% of your base mana every 2 sec. Lasts longer per combo point:    1 point  : 18% base mana over 6  secs    2 points: 36% base mana over 12  secs     3 points: 54% base mana over 18  secs    4 points: 72% base mana over 24  secs    5 points: 90% base mana over 30 secs

Name: Mutilate
Description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 100% weapon damage plus an additional 36 with each weapon. Awards 2 combo points.    Damage is increased by 20% against Poisoned targets.

Name: Poison Mastery
Description: You gain Poison Mastery when learning any Rogue Poison.     This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Essential Rogue Poisons when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.   Instant Poison Coats a melee or ranged weapon with a poison that deals nature damage.    Crippling Poison Coats a weapon with crippling poison that slows the target.   Mind-numbing Poison Coats a weapon with mind-numbing poison that reduces their casting speed.   Deadly Poison Coats your weapon with a deadly poison that causes your targets to take Nature damage over times and stacks up.    Wound Poison Coats your weapon with a poison that deals Nature damage and reduces the target's healing received.    Anesthetic Poison Coats your weapon with poison that deals Nature damage and dispels Enrage effects on your target.

Name: Rupture
Description: Finishing move that causes damage over time.  Lasts longer per combo point:     1 point  : 40 damage over 8 sec     2 points: 61 damage over 10 sec     3 points: 87 damage over 12 sec     4 points: 117 damage over 14 sec     5 points: 153 damage over 16 sec

Name: Slice and Dice
Description: Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 20%. Lasts longer per combo point:     1 point  : 9 seconds     2 points: 12 seconds     3 points: 15 seconds     4 points: 18 seconds     5 points: 21 seconds    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Smoke Bomb
Description: Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around you for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Adrenaline Rush
Description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Backstab
Description: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 10 to the target. Must be behind the target.  Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Blade Flurry
Description: Increases your melee attack speed by 20%. In addition, attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 20 sec.    Can't be active at the same time as Sweeping Strikes.     This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Evasion
Description: Increases your dodge chance by 50% and reduces the chance ranged attacks hit you by 50%. Lasts 15 sec.     This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fan of Knives
Description: Instantly throw both weapons at all targets within 8 yards, causing 105% weapon damage with daggers, and 70% weapon damage with all other weapons.

Name: Feint
Description: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.  In addition, reduces the damage you take from area of effect attacks by 20% for 6 sec.

Name: Gouge
Description: Causes 4 damage, incapacitating the opponent for 4 sec, and turns off your attack.  Target must be facing you.  Any damage caused will revive the target. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Grappling Hook
Description: Launch a grappling hook and pull yourself to the target location. For 3 sec after using it you can recast it, pulling yourself to an enemy and rooting them for 1 sec. Does not break stealth.

Name: Kick
Description: A quick kick that interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.     This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Killing Spree
Description: Step through the shadows from enemy to enemy within 10 yards, attacking an enemy for 130% weapon damage (195% with Daggers) every 0.5 sec with both weapons until 5 assaults are made.  Can hit the same target multiple times.  Cannot hit invisible or stealthed targets.

Name: Recuperate
Description: Finishing move that consumes combo points on your target to restore 3% of your maximum health every 3 sec. Lasts longer per combo point:    1 point : 3 seconds    2 points: 6 seconds    3 points: 9 seconds    4 points: 12 seconds    5 points: 15 seconds

Name: Riposte
Description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.  This attack deals 150% weapon damage and slows their melee attack speed by 20% for 30 sec. Awards 1 combo point. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Roll the Bones
Description: Roll the dice of fate, providing a random lesser or great combat enhancement for 10 sec. Only one enhancement can be active at the same time.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Shiv
Description: Performs an instant off-hand weapon attack that automatically applies the poison from your off-hand weapon to the target.  Slower weapons require more Energy. Shiv can not critically strike. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Shuriken Toss
Description: A ranged attack that deals 30 to 29 Physical damage to an enemy target. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Sinister Strike
Description: An instant strike that causes 3 damage in addition to 100% of your normal weapon damage (85% if a Two-Handed weapon is equipped). Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Sprint
Description: Increases your movement speed by 50% for 15 sec.  Does not break stealth.

Name: Blind
Description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec.  Any damage caused will remove the effect.

Name: Cloak of Shadows
Description: Instantly removes all existing harmful spell effects, Increases your chance to resist all spells by 90% for 5 sec.     Does not remove effects that prevent you from using Cloak of Shadows.

Name: Detect Traps
Description: Greatly increased chance to detect traps.

Name: Disarm Trap
Description: Disarm a hostile trap.

Name: Distract
Description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby monsters for 10 seconds.  Does not break stealth.

Name: Ghostly Strike
Description: A strike that deals 125% weapon damage (180% if a dagger is equipped, 100% if a Two-Handed weapon is equipped).     Increases your chance to dodge (or parry if a single Two-Handed weapon is equipped) by 10% for 8 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Gloomblade
Description: Punctures the target with your shadow-infused blade, causing 90% weapon damage as Shadow and inflicting Gloomblade for 6 sec, causing your melee abilities on the target to trigger additional 17 Shadow damage. Awards 1 combo point.

Name: Hemorrhage
Description: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage and applies Hemorrhage, increasing Physical damage taken by up to 9. Lasts 10 charges or 15 sec. Awards 1 combo point.    Deals 175% weapon damage if a dagger is equipped and 85% if a two-hander is equipped.

Name: Pick Lock
Description: Allows opening of locked chests and doors.

Name: Pick Pocket
Description: Pick the target's pocket, taking loot from them!

Name: Premeditation
Description: When used, adds 2 combo points to your target. Must be stealthed. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Preparation
Description: When activated, this ability immediately resets the cooldown on your Evasion, Sprint, Vanish, Cold Blood and Shadowstep abilities.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Safe Fall
Description: Reduces damage from falling.

Name: Sap
Description: Incapacitates the target for up to 25 sec (10 seconds on players).  Must be stealthed. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat.  Any damage caused will revive the target. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.

Name: Shadow Dance
Description: Enter the Shadow Dance for 8 sec, allowing the use of Sap, Garrote, Ambush, Cheap Shot, Premeditation, Pickpocket, Disarm Trap, Ravage and Pounce regardless of being stealthed or prowled.

Name: Shadowstep
Description: Attempts to step through the shadows and reappear behind your enemy and increases movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Stealth
Description: Allows you to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Removes invulnerabilities when used. Lasts until cancelled.

Name: Tricks of the Trade
Description: The party or raid member you have targeted receives the threat caused by your next damaging attack and all threat you cause for 6 sec. Their damage is increased by 15%.

Name: Vanish
Description: Allows you to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec.  Also breaks movement impairing effects.

Name: Air Elemental Totem
Description: Summons an elemental totem that calls forth a greater air elemental to rain destruction on the caster's enemies. Lasts 2 min.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.  This uses Fire Elemental Totem modifiers.

Name: Call of the Ancestors
Description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements.

Name: Call of the Elements
Description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar.

Name: Call of the Spirits
Description: Simultaneously places up to 4 totems specified in the Totem Bar. Can call different totems than Call of the Elements or Call of the Ancestors.

Name: Capacitor Totem
Description: Summons an Air totem with 5 health within 20 yards that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and then explodes after 2 sec to deal Nature damage and stun all enemies within 8 yards for 4 sec.  Deals 300% increased damage versus targets permanently immune to stuns.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Chain Lightning
Description: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 85 to 96 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Each jump reduces the damage by 30%. Affects 3 total targets.

Name: Earth Shock
Description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 13 to 15 Nature damage and reducing melee attack speed by 10% for 8 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability shares a cooldown with Shaman Shock spells.

Name: Earthbind Totem
Description: Summons an Earthbind Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 45 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Earthquake
Description: You cause the earth to tremble at your target location, dealing Nature damage every 1 sec to enemies within an 8 yard radius and reducing their movement speed by 25%. Lasts 8 sec.  Enemies damaged by Earthquake are afflicted with Trembling. At 3 stacks, Trembling stuns the target for 3 sec. This effect can only occur once every 10 sec from any Earthquake effect.

Name: Elemental Blast
Description: Harness and direct the raw power of the elements towards an enemy target, dealing Elemental damage and increasing the caster's critical strike chance or spell casting speed for 8 seconds.

Name: Elemental Mastery
Description: When activated, your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Lava Burst becomes instant and costs no mana. In addition, you gain 10% spell haste for 15 sec.   Does not stack with other similar cast speed increasing effects.

Name: Fire Elemental Totem
Description: Summons an elemental totem that calls forth a greater fire elemental to rain destruction on the caster's enemies.  Lasts 2 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fire Nova
Description: Causes your active Fire Totem to emit a wave of flames, inflicting 48 to 56 Fire damage to enemies within 10 yards of the totem.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Flame Ascendance
Description: Transform into a being of raw elemental energy for 15 sec, casting Flame Shock on up to 10 nearby enemies within 10 yards if known. Chain Lightning becomes Lava Beam. Lava Burst's cooldown is reduced by 50%.      Lava Beam Unleash a blast of superheated flame at the enemy, dealing 186 Firestorm damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Affects 3 total targets.    Lava Beam cannot be cast unless you're affected by Flame Ascendance.

Name: Flame Shock
Description: Instantly sears the target with fire, causing 21 Fire damage immediately and 42 Fire damage over 18 sec. This periodic damage may critically strike and will occur more rapidly based on the caster's spell haste.   This ability shares a cooldown with Shaman Shock spells.

Name: Frost Shock
Description: Instantly shocks the target with frost, causing 89 to 95 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50%. Lasts 8 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.  This ability shares a cooldown with other Shaman Shock spells.

Name: Hex
Description: Transforms the enemy into a frog. While hexed, the target cannot attack or cast spells. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Lasts 30 sec. Only one target can be hexed at a time. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.

Name: Lava Burst
Description: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 174 to 221 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst will deal a critical strike.

Name: Lightning Bolt
Description: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 13 to 15 Nature damage.

Name: Magma Totem
Description: Summons a Magma Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 20 sec that causes 38 Fire damage to creatures within 8 yards every 2 seconds.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Petrification Totem
Description: Summons a Petrification Totem with 5 health at your feet for 5 sec, slowing enemies within 8 yards. After 3 seconds, it Petrifies enemies for 5 seconds.    Petrified Asleep. Damage taken reduced by 50%. Effect breaks on any damage taken. This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Purge
Description: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial magic effect.

Name: Searing Totem
Description: Summons a Searing Totem with 5 health at your feet for 45 sec that repeatedly attacks an enemy within 20 yards for 11 to 14 Fire damage.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Stoneclaw Totem
Description: Summons a Stoneclaw Totem with 50 health at the feet of the caster for 15 sec that taunts creatures within 8 yards to attack it.  Enemies attacking the Stoneclaw Totem have a 50% chance to be stunned for 3 sec. Stoneclaw totem also protects all your totems, causing them to absorb 21 damage.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Tether Elemental
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to tether an Elemental companion.    Teaches you Tether Elemental, Raise Elemental, Dismiss Elemental, Revive Elemental and Elemental Lore.      Tether Elemental Begins tethering an elemental to be your companion.     Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on dominating the elemental for 20 sec.     If you lose the elemental's attention for any reason, the domination process will fail.     Each type of elemental has unique abilities that you will be able to make use of.

Name: Thunderstorm
Description: You call down a bolt of lightning, energizing you and damaging nearby enemies within 10 yards. Restores 8% mana to you and deals 292 to 333 Nature damage to all nearby enemies, knocking them back 20 yards.    Usable while stunned.

Name: Totem of Wrath
Description: Summons a Totem of Wrath with 5 health at the feet of the caster.     The totem increases Intellect by 22 and spell power by 23 for all party and raid members, and increases critical strike chance against all nearby targets by 3%. Lasts 5 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Wind Shear
Description: Instantly blasts the target with a gust of wind, causing no damage but interrupting spellcasting and preventing spells of that school of magic from being cast for 2 sec.   This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Air Ascendance
Description: You surrender your physical form to the power of the elements, transforming into a being of raw elemental energy for 15 sec.     Your Stormstrike has a 30 yard range and deals extra Elemental damage.    The cooldown of Stormstrike is reset when using any Shaman Shock, Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning.

Name: Astral Recall
Description: Yanks the caster through the twisting nether back to Teldrassil.  Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

Name: Bloodlust
Description: Increases melee and ranged attack speed by 30% and casting speed by 20% for all party and raid members.  Lasts 40 sec.  After the completion of this effect, those affected will become Sated and unable to benefit from Bloodlust again for 10 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Earth Elemental Totem
Description: Summon an elemental totem that calls forth a greater earth elemental to protect the caster and her allies.  Lasts 2 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Feral Spirit
Description: Summons two Spirit Wolves under the command of the Shaman, lasting 45 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fire Resistance Totem
Description: Summons a Fire Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the fire resistance of party and raid members within 50 yards by 30.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Flametongue Totem
Description: Summons a Flametongue Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  Party and raid members within 50 yards of the totem have their Intellect increased by 2 and spell power increased by 2.  Lasts 5 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Flametongue Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with fire, increasing total Spell power by 7. Each auto attack and melee ability causes 4.2 to 13.0 additional fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Frost Resistance Totem
Description: Summons a Frost Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min. The totem increases party and raid members' frost resistance by 30, if within 50 yards.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Frostbrand Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with frost increasing your Frost spell power by 16. Each hit has a chance of causing 31 additional Frost damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Ghost Wolf
Description: Turns the caster into a Ghost Wolf, increasing speed by 30%. As a Ghost Wolf, effects that reduce movement speed may not bring you below your normal movement speed. Only usable outdoors.

Name: Grounding Totem
Description: Summons a Grounding Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that will redirect one harmful spell from the caster to itself, destroying the totem. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 45 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Lava Lash
Description: You charge your off-hand weapon with lava, instantly dealing 100% off-hand Weapon damage as Firestrike damage.     The damage increased by 25% if your off-hand weapon is enchanted with Flametongue.

Name: Lightning Shield
Description: The caster is surrounded by 3 balls of lightning.  When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 13 Nature damage. This expends one lightning ball. Only one ball will fire every 3 seconds. Lasts 10 min.     Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Hero at any one time.

Name: Nature Resistance Totem
Description: Summons a Nature Resistance Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that increases the nature resistance of party and raid members within 50 yards by 30.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Rockbiter Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon, increasing attack power by 20. The attack power granted is doubled for two-handed weapons. You only gain 33% of the attack power while your Primary Stat is Intellect or Spirit. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Shamanistic Rage
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 30% and gives your successful melee and ranged attacks a chance to regenerate mana equal to 15% of your attack power. This spell is usable while stunned. Lasts 15 sec.    This ability is usable while Shapeshifted.

Name: Stoneskin Totem
Description: Summons a Stoneskin Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem protects party and raid members within 50 yards, increasing armor by 95. Lasts 5 min.   This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Stormstrike
Description: Instantly attack with both weapons for 100% weapon damage.  In addition, the next 4 sources of Nature damage dealt to the target from the Shaman are increased by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

Name: Strength of Earth Totem
Description: Summons a Strength of Earth Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem increases the Strength and Agility of all party and raid members within 50 yards by 8. Lasts 5 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Sundering
Description: Shatters a line of earth in front of you, causing 111 Firestrike damage and Incapacitating any enemy hit for 3 sec. This effect does not break from periodic Fire damage. Also, resets the cooldown of Lava Burst.

Name: Water Breathing
Description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 30 min and increases swim speed by 20%.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Water Walking
Description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Any damage will cancel the effect.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Windfury Totem
Description: Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem provides 16% melee haste to all party and raid members within 50 yards.  Lasts 5 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Windfury Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with wind.  Each hit has a 20% chance of dealing additional damage equal to two extra attacks with 46 extra attack power.    This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Wrath of Air Totem
Description: Summons a Wrath of Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem provides 5% spell haste to all party and raid members within 50 yards. Lasts 5 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Ancestral Spirit
Description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 65 health and 120 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

Name: Bind Elemental
Description: Binds the target hostile elemental for up to 50 sec. The bound unit is unable to move, attack or cast spells. Any damage caused will release the target. Only one target can be bound at a time.

Name: Chain Heal
Description: Heals the friendly target for 192 to 214, then jumps to heal additional nearby targets. If cast on a party member, the heal will only jump to other party members. Each jump reduces the effectiveness of the heal by 20%. Heals 3 total targets.

Name: Cleanse Spirit
Description: Cleanse the spirit of a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 curse effect.

Name: Cleansing Totem
Description: Summons a Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease and 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 3 seconds.  Lasts 5 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Cloudburst Totem
Description: Summons a totem with 5 health for 15 sec that stores 30% of your Nature healing. When it expires or is recalled, it heals injured allies within 40 yards, divided evenly. Recasting the spell recalls the totem and releases the healing.

Name: Cure Toxins
Description: Cures 1 poison effect and 1 disease effect on a friendly target.

Name: Earth Shield
Description: Protects the target with an earthen shield. Lasts 10 min or 6 charges.     Attacks heal the shielded target for 53 (increased by 25% against monsters) and reduce casting or channel time lost when damaged by 34%.     This effect can only occur once every 3 seconds.    Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time.

Name: Earthliving Weapon
Description: Imbue your weapon with earthen life. Increases healing done by 26 and each direct heal has a 20% chance to proc Earthliving on the target, healing an additional 64 over 12 sec. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

Name: Healing Rain
Description: Calls forth healing rains to blanket the area, restoring health over time up to 5 party or raid members in a 10 yard area every 2 sec for 8 sec. This periodic effect can critically strike.

Name: Healing Stream Totem
Description: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 6 every 2 seconds.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Healing Wave
Description: Heals a friendly target for 30 to 37.

Name: Lesser Healing Wave
Description: Heals a friendly target for 103 to 116.

Name: Mana Spring Totem
Description: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 16 mana every 5 seconds to all party and raid members within 30 yards.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Mana Tide Totem
Description: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 10% of the caster's health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 5% of total mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Nature's Swiftness
Description: When activated, your next Shaman Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. becomes instant and increases your cast speed by 10% for 20 sec. Does not stack with other similar cast speed increasing effects.

Name: Reincarnation
Description: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana.    This has a 30 minute cooldown.

Name: Riptide
Description: Heals a friendly target for 117 to 126 and another 205 over 15 sec.  Your next Chain Heal cast on that primary target within 15 sec will consume the healing over time effect and increase the amount of the Chain Heal by 25%.

Name: Tidal Force
Description: Call upon the power of the Tides to empower your heals for 10 sec.  Healing Wave: Heals the target again for 30% of the original amount healed after 1 second.  Lesser Healing Wave: Increases your healing on the target by 5% for 8 seconds, stacks up to 3 times.  Chain Heal: No longer diminishes in healing with each jump.  Healing Rain: Duration is increased by 50%.

Name: Totemic Recall
Description: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 50% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Tremor Totem
Description: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards.  Lasts 5 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Water Elemental Totem
Description: Summons an elemental totem that calls forth a greater water elemental to rain destruction on the caster's enemies. Lasts 2 min.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.  This uses Fire Elemental Totem modifiers.

Name: Water Shield
Description: The caster is surrounded by 5 globes of water, granting 10 mana per 5 sec. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, 40 mana is restored to the caster. This expends one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Name: Windwalk Totem
Description: Summons an Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 6 sec, granting party members within 10 yards Windwalk. Their movement speed is increased by 20% and cannot go below 100% speed while affected.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Corruption
Description: Corrupts the target, causing 28 Shadow damage over 12 sec.

Name: Curse of Agony
Description: Curses the target with agony, causing 36 Shadow damage over 24 sec.  This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

Name: Curse of Doom
Description: Curses the target with impending doom, causing 1518 Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target yields experience or honor when it dies from this damage, a Doomguard will be summoned.      Cannot be cast on players.

Name: Curse of Exhaustion
Description: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec.

Name: Curse of the Elements
Description: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Arcane, Fire, Frost, Nature, and Shadow resistances by 45 and increasing magic damage taken by 8%.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Curse of Tongues
Description: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 25%. Lasts 30 sec.    Lasts 12 seconds on players.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Curse of Weakness
Description: Target's attack power is reduced by 21 and armor is reduced by 5% for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.  Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Dark Pact
Description: Drains 221 of your summoned demon's mana, returning 100% to you.

Name: Death Coil
Description: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes 244 Shadow damage. The caster gains 300% of the damage caused in health.

Name: Drain Life
Description: Transfers 10 health every 1 sec from the target to the caster.  Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Drain Mana
Description: Transfers 3% of target's maximum mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster (up to a maximum of 6% of the caster's maximum mana every 1 sec).  Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Drain Soul
Description: Drains the soul of the target dealing 55 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Deals Four times damage to targets at or below 25% health.    If the target dies while being drained, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.  Each time the Drain Soul damages the target, it also has a chance to generate a Soul Shard.  Soul Shards are required for other spells.    Deals three times damage to players.

Name: Fear
Description: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to 10 sec. (6 seconds on players). Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

Name: Haunt
Description: You send a ghostly soul into the target, dealing 212 to 250 Shadow damage and increasing all damage done by your Shadow damage-over-time effects on the target by 20% for 12 sec.    When the Haunt spell ends or is dispelled, the soul returns to you, healing you for 100% of the damage. (up to 20% of your Maximum Health).

Name: Howl of Terror
Description: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for 6 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Life Tap
Description: Converts 15 health into 15 mana.  Spell power increases the amount of mana returned.

Name: Seed of Corruption
Description: Imbeds a demon seed in the enemy target, causing 480 Shadow damage over 18 sec.  When the target takes 0 total damage or dies, the seed will inflict 571 to 655 Shadow damage to all enemies within 15 yards of the target.

Name: Soul Swap
Description: You copy your damage-over-time effects from the target, preserving their power and duration.  For 5 sec afterwards, the next target you cast Soul Swap: Exhale on will be afflicted by the copied damage-over-time effects.  You cannot Soul Swap to the same target.

Name: Unstable Affliction
Description: Shadow energy slowly destroys the target, causing 550 damage over 15 sec.  In addition, if the Unstable Affliction is dispelled it will cause 990 damage to the dispeller and silence them for 5 sec. This spell benefits from haste.

Name: Banish
Description: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 20 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Casting Banish on a banished target will cancel the spell. Only works on Demons and Elementals.    Lasts 6 seconds on players.

Name: Blood Horror
Description: While channeling, encases yourself in a barrier of blood, making you immune to interrupts, silences and stuns. Any time an enemy within 15 yards deals non-periodic damage to you, you drain their health and cause them to run in horror for 4 sec.

Name: Create Firestone
Description: While applied to target weapon it increases damage dealt by spells by 1% and spell critical strike rating by 7. This effect lasts for 2 hours.     You can only benefit from one Warlock weapon enchant at a time.

Name: Create Healthstone
Description: Creates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 100 health.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Create Soulstone
Description: Creates a Minor Soulstone. The Soulstone can be used to store one target's soul.  If the target dies while his soul is stored, he will be able to resurrect with 400 health and 700 mana.  Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Name: Create Spellstone
Description: While applied to target weapon it increases damage dealt by periodic spells by 2% and spell haste rating by 7. This effect lasts for 2 hours.    You can only benefit from one Warlock weapon enchant at a time.

Name: Dark Apotheosis
Description: Your threat generated is significantly increased.    Teaches you Challenging Howl and Demon Claws.    Dark Apotheosis cannot cower behind a shield. Shields cannot be equipped while transformed.      Demon Claws 15 Rage Requires  Dark Apotheosis Strike twice, dealing 8 Physical damage per strike.   Challenging Howl 30 yd range 8 sec cooldown Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.    Shares a cooldown with other single target taunt abilities and Distracting Shot. Can only be cast while in Dark Apotheosis.    This spell cannot miss and is automatically learned and unlearned with Dark Apotheosis.

Name: Demon Skin
Description: Protects the caster, increasing armor by 54, and healing received by 5%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.     Lasts until cancelled.

Name: Demonic Circle: Summon
Description: You summon a Demonic Circle at your feet, lasting 6 min. You can only have one Demonic Circle active at a time.

Name: Demonic Empowerment
Description: Grants the Warlock's summoned demon Empowerment.  Imp - Increases the Imp's spell critical strike chance by 20% for 30 sec.  Voidwalker - Increases the Voidwalker's health by 20%, and its threat generated from spells and attacks by 20% for 20 sec.  Succubus - Instantly vanishes, causing the Succubus to go into an improved Invisibility state. The vanish effect removes all stuns, snares and movement impairing effects from the Succubus.  Felhunter - Dispels all magical effects from the Felhunter.  Felguard - Increases the Felguard's attack speed by 20% and breaks all stun, snare and movement impairing effects and makes your Felguard immune to them for 15 sec.

Name: Demonic Leap
Description: Leap into the air upon demonic wings, moving a short distance. If you reactivate it within 1 sec you will leap again.

Name: Detect Invisibility
Description: Allows the friendly target to detect lesser invisibility for 10 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Enslave Demon
Description: Teaches you the necessary abilities to Enslave a Demon companion.  Teaches you Enslave Demon, Summon Demon, Dismiss Demon, Revive Demon and Demon Lore.      Enslave Demon Begins enslaving a demon to be your companion.     Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the demon for 20 sec.     If you lose the demon's attention for any reason, the enslaving process will fail. Each type of demon has unique abilities that you will be able to make use of.

Name: Eye of Kilrogg
Description: Summons an Eye of Kilrogg and binds your vision to it. The eye moves quickly but is very fragile.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Fel Armor
Description: Surrounds you with fel energy, increasing spell power by 40 plus 30% of your Spirit.   Restores 2% of your max health every 5 sec.     Only one Armor spell can be active at a time. Lasts until cancelled.

Name: Fel Domination
Description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter or Felguard Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

Name: Health Funnel
Description: Gives 12 health to the caster's pet every second for 10 sec as long as the caster channels.

Name: Inferno
Description: Summons a meteor from the Twisting Nether, causing 200 Fire damage and stunning all enemy targets in the area for 2 sec. An Infernal rises from the crater, under the command of the caster for 1 min.

Name: Metamorphosis
Description: You transform into a Demon for 30 sec.     This form grants you some unique demon abilities in addition to your normal abilities.     You may only use spells and abilities that deal Fire or Shadow damage(and spells usable while shapeshifted) in this form.    This form increases your armor from cloth and leather by 130%.    Increases your damage by 20%.    Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6% and reduces the duration of stun and snare effects by 50%.

Name: Reign of Dread
Description: Surge into the air and scorch all enemies below with 119 to 144 Shadowflame damage over 2 sec.    Can be channeled while moving. While airborne, your movement speed is reduced by 25% and melee attacks against you have 60% increased chance to miss.

Name: Ritual of Doom
Description: Begins a ritual that sacrifices a random participant's health to summon a doomguard. Requires the caster and 4 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Name: Ritual of Souls
Description: Begins a ritual that creates a Soulwell. Raid members can click the Soulwell to acquire a Major Healthstone. The Soulwell lasts for 3 min or 25 charges.     Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must right-click the soul portal and not move until the ritual is complete.

Name: Ritual of Summoning
Description: Begins a ritual that creates a summoning portal. The summoning portal can be used by 2 party or raid members to summon a targeted party or raid member.      The ritual portal requires the caster and 2 additional party or raid members to complete.     In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete.     Cannot be used in High-Risk mode

Name: Shadow Ward
Description: Absorbs 290 Shadow damage. Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Soul Harvest
Description: Increases your magic damage and your pets' damage by 15%. Lasts 6 sec, increased by 3 sec for each target afflicted by your Corruption, Curse of Agony, Immolate, Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague, up to a maximum of 24 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Soul Link
Description: When active, 20% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Summoned or Enslaved Demon or your Ghoul summoned through Master of Ghouls. That damage cannot be prevented. Lasts as long as the linked pet is active, controlled and you are within 30 yards of it.

Name: Soulshatter
Description: Reduces threat by 50% for all enemies within 50 yards.

Name: Summon Felguard
Description: Summons a Felguard under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summon Felhunter
Description: Summons a Felhunter under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summon Imp
Description: Summons an Imp under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summon Succubus
Description: Summons a Succubus under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summon Voidwalker
Description: Summons a Voidwalker under the command of the Warlock.

Name: Summoner's Armor
Description: Empowers your tamed beast, tamed dragonkin, dominated undead, enslaved demon, summoned demon, wild imp or tethered elemental, increasing their critical strike chance with spells and abilities by 2% and their spell damage done by 3%.  Only one type of Warlock Armor spell can be active at any time.

Name: Temporary Enslaved Demon
Description: Enslaves the target demon, up to level 32, forcing it to do your bidding. While enslaved, the time between the demon's attacks is increased by 30% and its casting speed is slowed by 20%. Lasts up to 5 min.

Name: Unending Breath
Description: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 30 min.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Unending Resolve
Description: Hardens your skin, reducing all damage taken by 30% and preventing your spells from being interrupted or silenced for 6 sec.

Name: Burning Rush
Description: Drains 5% of your maximum health every 2 seconds to increase your movement speed by 50%. This damage does not break crowd control effects.     Allows you to cast Fire spells while moving, and movement-impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts for 6 sec.

Name: Chaos Bolt
Description: Sends a bolt of chaotic fire at the enemy, dealing 518 Shadowflame damage. Chaos Bolt cannot be resisted, and pierces through all absorption, deflection, and reflection effects.

Name: Conflagrate
Description: Consumes an Immolate or Shadowflame effect on the enemy target to instantly deal damage equal to 60% of your Immolate or Shadowflame, and causes an additional 40% damage over 6 sec. This periodic damage may critically strike.

Name: Hand of Gul'dan
Description: Calls down a demonic meteor dealing Shadowflame damage to enemies within 5 yards and summons 4 Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target for 10 sec.

Name: Hellfire
Description: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing 83 periodic Fire damage to herself and 83 periodic Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Immolate
Description: Burns the enemy for 8 Fire damage and then an additional 20 Fire damage over 15 sec.

Name: Incinerate
Description: Deals 100 to 118 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25 to 30 Fire damage if the target is affected by an Immolate spell.

Name: Rain of Fire
Description: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for 480 Fire damage over 8 sec.

Name: Searing Pain
Description: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 30 to 37 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Shadow Bolt
Description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 16 to 21 Shadow damage.

Name: Shadowburn
Description: Instantly blasts the target for 102 Shadowflame damage.     If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

Name: Shadowflame
Description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 61 to 66 Shadowflame damage and an additional 64 Shadowflame damage over 8 sec.

Name: Shadowfury
Description: Shadowfury is unleashed, causing 208 to 245 Shadow damage and stunning all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.

Name: Soul Fire
Description: Burn the enemy's soul, causing 265 Fire damage.

Name: Avatar
Description: Transform into an unstoppable colossus for 12 sec, causing you to deal 15% increased Physical damage and take 20% less damage.    While in this state you move at 80% speed which cannot be reduced or increased. You are also immune to immobilizing effects.

Name: Battle Stance
Description: A balanced combat stance that increases the armor penetration of all of physical attacks by 10%.

Name: Bladestorm
Description: Instantly Whirlwind up to 4 nearby targets and for the next 6 sec you will perform a whirlwind attack every 1 sec.  While under the effects of Bladestorm, you can move but cannot perform any other abilities but you do not feel pity or remorse or fear and you cannot be stopped unless disarmed or killed.

Name: Charge
Description: Charge an enemy, generate 12 rage, and root it for 1.50 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Colossus Smash
Description: Smashes a target for 150% weapon damage, which ignores armor, to weaken their defenses, allowing your attacks to bypass 30% of their armor for 6 sec.

Name: Demoralizing Banner
Description: Throw down a war banner that decreases the armor of all enemies within 30 yards by 20% and their critical strike chance by 10%. Lasts 15 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.  You can Intervene to your war banner.  This ability can be used while shapeshifted.

Name: Hamstring
Description: Attack the enemy for 3 damage and maims the enemy, reducing movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Lasts 10sec vs players.

Name: Heroic Leap
Description: Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal Physical damage and slow all enemies within 8 yards by 50% for 2 sec. While in the air you are immune to crowd control effects.  Usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Heroic Strike
Description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 11 and causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Heroic Throw
Description: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing 18 damage (based on attack power).  This ability causes high threat.

Name: Mocking Blow
Description: A mocking attack, dealing weapon damage, that causes a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Name: Mortal Strike
Description: A vicious strike that deals 100% weapon damage plus 55 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Overpower
Description: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing 100% weapon damage. Only usable after the target dodges. The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

Name: Ravager
Description: Throws a whirling weapon at the target location, inflicting 80% weapon damage plus 65 to all enemies every second over 8 sec.    Ravager hits with your off-hand weapon while wielding one-handed weapons.

Name: Rend
Description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 25 damage plus an additional 2 (based on weapon damage) over 15 sec.    While wielding a single Two-Handed weapon, this periodic damage can critically strike.

Name: Retaliation
Description: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 12 sec.  Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked.  A maximum of 20 attacks will cause retaliation.

Name: Shattering Throw
Description: Throws your weapon at the enemy causing 18 damage (based on attack power) and removing any invulnerabilities.     If no invulnerability is removed, you lower the target's armor by 20% for 10 seconds and reduce the cooldown of your next Shattering Throw by 30 seconds.

Name: Skull Banner
Description: Throw down a war banner at your feet that increases the melee and ranged critical strike chance of party or raid members within 40 yards of the banner by 20%. Lasts 10 sec.  Allies receiving this effect will become Fatigued and unable to benefit from Skull Banner for 3 min.  You can Intervene to your war banner.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Sweeping Strikes
Description: While active, casting a melee ability that deals damage will cause a Sweeping Strike, dealing 40% weapon damage to 5 nearby enemies, further increased by attack power. Lasts 10 sec.    Can't be active at the same time as Blade Flurry.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Thunder Clap
Description: Blasts nearby enemies dealing 15 damage and increasing the time between their attacks by 10% for 10 sec. This ability causes additional threat.

Name: Battle Shout
Description: Increases the Strength and Agility of all raid and party members within 30 yards by 2. Lasts 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Berserker Rage
Description: The warrior enters a berserker rage, removing and granting immunity to Fear, Sap and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage.  Lasts 10 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Berserker Stance
Description: An aggressive stance. Critical hit chance is increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 5%.

Name: Bloodbath
Description: For the next 5 sec, causes your Physical melee abilities to deal 50 bleed damage over 5 sec and reduces the movement speed of the target by 30% for 3 sec.    This ability can be used while shapeshifted.

Name: Bloodthirst
Description: Instantly attack the target causing 7 damage. Each bleed applied by you increases the damage of Bloodthirst by 8%, up to a maximum of 40%. In addition, the next 3 successful melee attacks will restore 1% of max health. This effect lasts 8 sec. Damage is based on your attack power.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Challenging Shout
Description: Forces all enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

Name: Cleave
Description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 13 to the target and his nearest ally.

Name: Commanding Shout
Description: Increases maximum health of all party and raid members within 30 yards by 266. Lasts 30 min.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Death Wish
Description: When activated you become enraged, increasing your physical damage by 15% but increasing all damage taken by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Demoralizing Shout
Description: Reduces the attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 35 for 30 sec.   Does not stack with other similar effects.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Enraged Regeneration
Description: You regenerate 30% of your total health over 10 sec.  This ability requires an Enrage effect, consumes all Enrage effects and prevents any from affecting you for the full duration.

Name: Execute
Description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 65 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 2 additional damage (up to a maximum cost of 30 rage). Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

Name: Heroic Fury
Description: Removes any movement impairing effects and refreshes the cooldown of your Intercept and Siegebreaker abilities.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Intercept
Description: Charge an enemy, causing 1 damage (based on attack power) and stunning it for 3 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Intimidating Shout
Description: The caster shouts, causing up to 5 enemies within 8 yards to cower in fear for 8 seconds. The targeted enemy will be unable to move while cowering.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Piercing Howl
Description: Causes all enemies within 10 yards to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.  This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Pummel
Description: Pummel the target, interrupting spellcasting and preventing spells of that school from being cast for 4 sec.    This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Raging Blow
Description: A mighty blow that deals 125% weapon damage from both melee weapons. Requires a weapon in the mainhand and off-hand to use.  Becoming Enraged enables one use of Raging Blow. You can store up to 2 charges.    Multiple Raging Blow! charges cannot be gained within the same global cooldown. Does not receive a charge from Wrecking Crew.

Name: Rampage
Description: Increases ranged and melee critical strike chance of all party and raid members within 100 yds by 5%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Recklessness
Description: Your attack speed is increased by 30%, but all damage taken is increased by 10%. Your next 3 non-periodic Warrior abilities have an additional 100% to critically hit, 3 yards extra range and will cause you to charge toward your enemy if not in melee range already. Lasts for 8 sec.    Charges are not consumed versus monsters.    While active, the duration of stun and movement impairing effects on you is reduced by 50%.

Name: Siegebreaker
Description: Use your full strength to slam the target with your weapon, dealing 150% weapon damage to up to 5 nearby enemies in a conal attack.  If the target is a player, it also knocks them back. Enemies the target collides with are knocked back slightly and take 150% weapon damage.

Name: Single-Minded Fury
Description: While a one-handed weapon is equipped in both hands, your Mortal Strike, Overpower and Slam deal 5% less damage but will trigger an additional attack with your off-hand weapon.   Cannot be used with daggers.

Name: Slam
Description: Slams the opponent, causing 100% weapon damage plus 9.

Name: Titan's Grip
Description: Allows you to wield a Two-Handed Axe, Mace, or Sword in each hand.    Also allows for a weapon or shield to be held in the off-hand while a Staff is equipped.    Physical damage dealt is reduced by 10%.    While a Staff is equipped in your main hand, your Magic damage and healing done are reduced by 10%.

Name: Victory Rush
Description: Instantly attack the target causing 5 damage.  Can only be used within 20 sec after you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor. Damage is based on your attack power.

Name: Whirlwind
Description: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing 100% weapon damag from both melee weapons to each enemy.

Name: Bloodrage
Description: Generates 20 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Concussion Blow
Description: Stuns the opponent for 5 sec and deals 5 damage. (based on attack power).     Causes a High amount of threat.

Name: Defensive Stance
Description: Significantly Increases your threat generation.    Increases your armor by 10% and decreases damage taken by 10%.    Your damage and healing done is decreased by 5%.     Teaches you Taunt.

Name: Devastate
Description: Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect. In addition, causes 120% weapon damage (96% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 4 for each application of Sunder Armor on the target. The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 5 times.    Sunder Armor Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 30 sec. Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Disarm
Description: Disarm the enemy, removing their weapons, shields, or other equipment for 6 sec.

Name: Intervene
Description: Run at high speed towards a party or raid member, intercepting the next melee or ranged attack made against them and taunts up to 3 enemies attacking the target to attack you instead.

Name: Last Stand
Description: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec.  After the effect expires, the health is lost.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Revenge
Description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 88 to 107 damage.  Revenge is only usable after the warrior blocks, dodges or parries an attack.

Name: Shield Bash
Description: Bash the target with your shield dazing them and interrupting spellcasting, which prevents spells of that school from being cast for 6 sec.     This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.

Name: Shield Block
Description: Increases your chance to block and block value by 100% for 10 sec.

Name: Shield Slam
Description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 294 to 307 damage, modified by your shield block value, and dispels 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Shield Wall
Description: Reduces all damage taken by 60% for 12 sec.

Name: Shockwave
Description: Sends a wave of force in front of the caster, causing 6 damage (based on attack power) and stunning all enemy targets in a frontal cone for 4 sec.

Name: Spell Reflection
Description: Raise your shield, reflecting the next spell cast on you. Lasts 5 sec.

Name: Vigilance
Description: Focus your protective gaze on a group or raid target to reduce their damage taken by 3% and transfer 15% of the threat they cause to you.    Each time they are hit by an attack your Taunt and Growl cooldown is refreshed. Lasts 30 min. This effect can only be on one target at a time.
